challenges.sol: SELECT flight_number, departure_date, departure_time FROM flights WHERE status = 'Delayed' ORDER BY departure_date, departure_time, flight_number;
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM passengers WHERE nationality = 'French' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT v.flight_number, a.name, a.city FROM flights v JOIN airports a ON a.id = v.arrival_airport_id WHERE a.country = 'Spain' ORDER BY a.city, v.flight_number;
SELECT r.id, r.class, r.price, v.flight_number FROM bookings r JOIN flights v ON v.id = r.flight_id ORDER BY r.price DESC, r.id LIMIT 10;

SELECT b.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, v.flight_number FROM bags b JOIN bookings r ON r.id = b.booking_id JOIN passengers p ON p.id = r.passenger_id JOIN flights v ON v.id = r.flight_id WHERE b.status = 'Lost' ORDER BY b.id;
SELECT v.flight_number, v.departure_time, v.status FROM flights v JOIN airports a ON a.id = v.departure_airport_id WHERE a.city = 'Paris' ORDER BY v.departure_time, v.flight_number;
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, p.email FROM passengers p LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.passenger_id = p.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name;
SELECT v.flight_number, v.departure_date, v.status FROM flights v LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.departure_date, v.flight_number;
SELECT id, status, booking_id FROM bags WHERE weight_kg IS NULL ORDER BY id;

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.last_name, v.flight_number FROM bookings r JOIN passengers p ON p.id = r.passenger_id JOIN flights v ON v.id = r.flight_id WHERE r.class = 'Business' ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name, v.flight_number;
SELECT model, registration, capacity FROM aircraft WHERE capacity > 200 ORDER BY capacity DESC, registration;
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM passengers WHERE email LIKE '%.de' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT flight_number, departure_time, status FROM flights WHERE departure_date = '2025-06-13' ORDER BY departure_time, flight_number;
SELECT DISTINCT nationality FROM passengers ORDER BY nationality;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE class = 'Business';
SELECT id, weight_kg FROM bags WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY weight_kg DESC, id LIMIT 1;
SELECT first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM passengers WHERE birth_date < '1985-01-01' ORDER BY birth_date, last_name, first_name;
SELECT name, city, country FROM airports WHERE country IN ('Spain', 'Portugal') ORDER BY city, name;
SELECT name, country, code FROM airlines WHERE country <> 'France' ORDER BY name;
SELECT flight_number, departure_date, departure_time FROM flights WHERE departure_time < '09:00' ORDER BY departure_date, departure_time, flight_number;
SELECT class, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM bookings GROUP BY class ORDER BY avg_price DESC, class;
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS count FROM passengers GROUP BY nationality ORDER BY count DESC, nationality;
SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM bags;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT passenger_id) FROM bookings;
SELECT flight_number, departure_date, status FROM flights WHERE status = 'Delayed' OR status = 'Cancelled' ORDER BY flight_number;
SELECT model, registration, capacity FROM aircraft WHERE model NOT LIKE 'Airbus%' ORDER BY registration;
SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS traveler FROM passengers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM passengers WHERE strftime('%Y', birth_date) = '1990' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT id, price FROM bookings ORDER BY price DESC, id LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM flights GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC, status;
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS count FROM passengers GROUP BY nationality HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY count DESC, nationality;
SELECT SUM(capacity) FROM aircraft;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS bag_count FROM bags GROUP BY status ORDER BY bag_count DESC, status;

SELECT v.flight_number, v.departure_date, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count FROM flights v LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.flight_number, v.departure_date ORDER BY booking_count DESC, v.flight_number;
SELECT c.name, SUM(r.price) AS revenue FROM airlines c JOIN flights v ON v.airline_id = c.id JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT a.city, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count FROM flights v JOIN airports a ON a.id = v.arrival_airport_id JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY booking_count DESC, a.city LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.id, v.flight_number, r.price FROM bookings r JOIN flights v ON v.id = r.flight_id WHERE r.class = 'Economy' AND r.price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM bookings WHERE class = 'Economy') ORDER BY r.price DESC, r.id;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM passengers p JOIN bookings r ON r.passenger_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.flight_id) >= 2 ORDER BY flight_count DESC, p.last_name, p.first_name;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name FROM passengers p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings r WHERE r.passenger_id = p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings r JOIN bags b ON b.booking_id = r.id WHERE r.passenger_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name;

SELECT v.flight_number, c.name, a.city, v.status FROM flights v JOIN airlines c ON c.id = v.airline_id JOIN airports a ON a.id = v.arrival_airport_id LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.departure_date, v.flight_number;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, SUM(r.price) AS total_spent FROM passengers p JOIN bookings r ON r.passenger_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING SUM(r.price) > 500 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, p.last_name, p.first_name;

SELECT v.flight_number, av.capacity, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(r.id) / av.capacity, 1) AS fill_rate_pct FROM flights v JOIN aircraft av ON av.id = v.aircraft_id LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.flight_number, av.capacity HAVING 100.0 * COUNT(r.id) / av.capacity > 3 ORDER BY fill_rate_pct DESC, v.flight_number;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT v.arrival_airport_id) AS destination_count FROM airlines c JOIN flights v ON v.airline_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.arrival_airport_id) >= 3 ORDER BY destination_count DESC, c.name;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.class) AS class_count FROM passengers p JOIN bookings r ON r.passenger_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.class) >= 2 ORDER BY class_count DESC, p.last_name, p.first_name;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booking_date) AS month, class, COUNT(*) AS booking_count, ROUND(AVG(price), 0) AS avg_price FROM bookings GROUP BY month, class ORDER BY month, class;

SELECT v.flight_number, a.city, COUNT(DISTINCT p.nationality) AS nationality_count, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count FROM flights v JOIN airports a ON a.id = v.arrival_airport_id JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id JOIN passengers p ON p.id = r.passenger_id GROUP BY v.id, v.flight_number, a.city HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.nationality) >= 3 ORDER BY nationality_count DESC, booking_count DESC, v.flight_number;

SELECT c.name, SUM(CASE WHEN r.class = 'Economy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS economy_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.class = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS premium_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.class = 'Business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS business_count FROM airlines c JOIN flights v ON v.airline_id = c.id JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY economy_count DESC, c.name;

SELECT c.name AS airline, COUNT(DISTINCT r.passenger_id) AS passenger_count FROM airlines c JOIN flights v ON v.airline_id = c.id JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY passenger_count DESC, c.name;

SELECT a.city, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC) AS rank FROM flights v JOIN airports a ON a.id = v.arrival_airport_id JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY rank, a.city;

WITH totals AS (SELECT p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(r.price), 0) AS total FROM passengers p LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.passenger_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name), average AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS value FROM totals) SELECT t.first_name, t.last_name, t.total, ROUND(t.total - m.value, 2) AS diff_from_average FROM totals t CROSS JOIN average m WHERE t.total > m.value ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.last_name, t.first_name;

SELECT v.flight_number, av.capacity, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(r.id) / av.capacity, 1) AS fill_rate_pct FROM flights v JOIN aircraft av ON av.id = v.aircraft_id LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.flight_number, av.capacity ORDER BY fill_rate_pct DESC, v.flight_number;

SELECT v.flight_number, COALESCE(SUM(r.price), 0) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(r.price), 0) DESC) AS rank FROM flights v JOIN airlines c ON c.id = v.airline_id LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id WHERE c.name = 'AlphaJet' GROUP BY v.id, v.flight_number ORDER BY rank, v.flight_number;

WITH history AS (SELECT r.id AS booking_id, v.flight_number, r.booking_date, r.price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.booking_date, r.id) AS step_number, LAG(r.price) OVER (ORDER BY r.booking_date, r.id) AS previous_price FROM bookings r JOIN passengers p ON p.id = r.passenger_id JOIN flights v ON v.id = r.flight_id WHERE p.first_name = 'Oliver' AND p.last_name = 'Smith') SELECT step_number, flight_number, booking_date, price, previous_price, price - previous_price AS difference FROM history ORDER BY booking_date, booking_id;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT v.airline_id) AS airline_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM passengers p JOIN bookings r ON r.passenger_id = p.id JOIN flights v ON v.id = r.flight_id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.airline_id) >= 2 ORDER BY airline_count DESC, flight_count DESC, p.last_name, p.first_name;

WITH stats AS (SELECT v.id AS flight_id, v.flight_number, v.airline_id, c.name AS airline, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count FROM flights v JOIN airlines c ON c.id = v.airline_id LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.flight_number, v.airline_id, c.name), averages AS (SELECT airline_id, AVG(booking_count) AS average FROM stats GROUP BY airline_id) SELECT s.flight_number, s.airline, s.booking_count, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS airline_average FROM stats s JOIN averages m ON m.airline_id = s.airline_id WHERE s.booking_count > m.average ORDER BY s.airline, s.booking_count DESC, s.flight_number;

SELECT c.name AS airline, r.class, SUM(r.price) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(r.price) DESC) AS class_rank FROM airlines c JOIN flights v ON v.airline_id = c.id JOIN bookings r ON r.flight_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, r.class ORDER BY c.name, class_rank, r.class;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, v.flight_number, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count FROM bookings r JOIN passengers p ON p.id = r.passenger_id JOIN flights v ON v.id = r.flight_id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, v.id, v.flight_number HAVING COUNT(r.id) > 1 ORDER BY booking_count DESC, p.last_name, p.first_name, v.flight_number;
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, h.start_date FROM hospital_stays h JOIN patients p ON p.id = h.patient_id WHERE h.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY h.start_date, h.id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM patients WHERE city = 'Paris' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT id, consultation_date, duration_min FROM consultations WHERE diagnosis IS NULL ORDER BY consultation_date, id;
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.specialty, m.hire_date FROM doctors m JOIN departments s ON s.id = m.department_id WHERE s.name = 'Cardiology' ORDER BY m.last_name, m.first_name;
SELECT h.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, h.start_date, h.end_date FROM hospital_stays h JOIN patients p ON p.id = h.patient_id WHERE h.end_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.end_date, h.id;
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, p.city FROM patients p LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.patient_id = p.id WHERE c.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name;
SELECT id, dosage, duration_days FROM prescriptions WHERE medication = 'Amoxicillin' ORDER BY duration_days DESC, id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM patients WHERE birth_date > '2000-01-01' ORDER BY birth_date, id;
SELECT c.id, m.first_name, m.last_name, c.consultation_date, c.duration_min FROM consultations c JOIN doctors m ON m.id = c.doctor_id WHERE c.duration_min > 40 ORDER BY c.duration_min DESC, c.id;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, c.consultation_date, m.last_name FROM consultations c JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id JOIN doctors m ON m.id = c.doctor_id JOIN departments s ON s.id = m.department_id WHERE s.name = 'Neurology' ORDER BY c.consultation_date, c.id;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(c.id) AS consultation_count FROM doctors m LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.doctor_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY consultation_count DESC, m.last_name, m.first_name;

SELECT s.name, ROUND(AVG(julianday(h.end_date) - julianday(h.start_date)), 1) AS avg_duration_days FROM departments s JOIN hospital_stays h ON h.department_id = s.id WHERE h.end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY avg_duration_days DESC, s.name;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(c.id) AS consultation_count, SUM(c.duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM patients p JOIN consultations c ON c.patient_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 2 ORDER BY consultation_count DESC, total_duration_min DESC, p.last_name, p.first_name;
SELECT s.name, COUNT(m.id) AS doctor_count FROM departments s LEFT JOIN doctors m ON m.department_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY doctor_count DESC, s.name;
SELECT medication, COUNT(*) AS prescription_count, ROUND(AVG(duration_days), 1) AS avg_duration_days FROM prescriptions GROUP BY medication ORDER BY prescription_count DESC, medication LIMIT 5;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, p.city FROM patients p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consultations c WHERE c.patient_id = p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hospital_stays h WHERE h.patient_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name;

SELECT c.id, c.consultation_date, COUNT(p.id) AS prescription_count FROM consultations c JOIN prescriptions p ON p.consultation_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.consultation_date HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 2 ORDER BY prescription_count DESC, c.id;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.department_id) AS department_count, COUNT(c.id) AS consultation_count FROM patients p JOIN consultations c ON c.patient_id = p.id JOIN doctors m ON m.id = c.doctor_id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.department_id) >= 2 ORDER BY department_count DESC, consultation_count DESC, p.last_name, p.first_name;

SELECT s.name, SUM(CASE WHEN c.diagnosis IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_diagnosis, COUNT(c.id) AS total_consultations FROM departments s JOIN doctors m ON m.department_id = s.id JOIN consultations c ON c.doctor_id = m.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN c.diagnosis IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY no_diagnosis DESC, s.name;
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients GROUP BY city ORDER BY patient_count DESC, city LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.name AS department, m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(c.id) AS consultation_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC) AS rank FROM departments s JOIN doctors m ON m.department_id = s.id LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.doctor_id = m.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, m.id, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY s.name, rank, m.last_name, m.first_name;

WITH patient_department AS (SELECT s.id AS department_id, s.name AS department, p.id AS patient_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(c.id) AS consultation_count FROM departments s JOIN doctors m ON m.department_id = s.id JOIN consultations c ON c.doctor_id = m.id JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name), averages AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(consultation_count) AS average FROM patient_department GROUP BY department_id) SELECT ps.department, ps.first_name, ps.last_name, ps.consultation_count, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS department_average FROM patient_department ps JOIN averages m ON m.department_id = ps.department_id WHERE ps.consultation_count > m.average ORDER BY ps.department, ps.consultation_count DESC, ps.last_name, ps.first_name;

SELECT c.consultation_date, c.duration_min, LAG(c.duration_min) OVER (ORDER BY c.consultation_date, c.id) AS previous_duration, c.duration_min - LAG(c.duration_min) OVER (ORDER BY c.consultation_date, c.id) AS difference FROM consultations c JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id WHERE p.first_name = 'Camille' AND p.last_name = 'Moreau' ORDER BY c.consultation_date, c.id;

SELECT s.name, s.bed_capacity, COUNT(h.id) AS current_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(h.id) / s.bed_capacity, 1) AS occupancy_rate_pct FROM departments s LEFT JOIN hospital_stays h ON h.department_id = s.id AND h.end_date IS NULL GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.bed_capacity ORDER BY occupancy_rate_pct DESC, s.name;

WITH departments_per_patient AS (SELECT p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.department_id) AS department_count FROM patients p JOIN consultations c ON c.patient_id = p.id JOIN doctors m ON m.id = c.doctor_id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name), average AS (SELECT AVG(department_count) AS value FROM departments_per_patient) SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.department_count, ROUND(m.value, 2) AS overall_average FROM departments_per_patient s CROSS JOIN average m WHERE s.department_count > m.value ORDER BY s.department_count DESC, s.last_name, s.first_name;

SELECT s.name, COUNT(p.id) AS prescription_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC) AS rank FROM departments s LEFT JOIN doctors m ON m.department_id = s.id LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.doctor_id = m.id LEFT JOIN prescriptions p ON p.consultation_id = c.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY rank, s.name;

WITH doctor_prescriptions AS (SELECT s.id AS department_id, s.name AS department, m.id AS doctor_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(p.id) AS prescription_count FROM departments s JOIN doctors m ON m.department_id = s.id LEFT JOIN consultations c ON c.doctor_id = m.id LEFT JOIN prescriptions p ON p.consultation_id = c.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, m.id, m.first_name, m.last_name), averages AS (SELECT department_id, AVG(prescription_count) AS average FROM doctor_prescriptions GROUP BY department_id) SELECT pm.department, pm.first_name, pm.last_name, pm.prescription_count, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS department_average FROM doctor_prescriptions pm JOIN averages m ON m.department_id = pm.department_id WHERE pm.prescription_count > m.average ORDER BY pm.department, pm.prescription_count DESC, pm.last_name, pm.first_name;

WITH consultation_departments AS (SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, c.consultation_date, c.id AS consultation_id, s.name AS department, LAG(s.name) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY c.consultation_date, c.id) AS previous_department FROM consultations c JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id JOIN doctors m ON m.id = c.doctor_id JOIN departments s ON s.id = m.department_id) SELECT first_name, last_name, consultation_date, department, previous_department FROM consultation_departments WHERE previous_department IS NOT NULL AND department <> previous_department ORDER BY last_name, first_name, consultation_date, consultation_id;

SELECT s.name AS department, p.sex, COUNT(c.id) AS consultation_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY COUNT(c.id) DESC) AS rank FROM departments s JOIN doctors m ON m.department_id = s.id JOIN consultations c ON c.doctor_id = m.id JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, p.sex ORDER BY s.name, rank, p.sex;

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name FROM patients p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consultations c WHERE c.patient_id = p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM departments s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consultations c JOIN doctors m ON m.id = c.doctor_id WHERE c.patient_id = p.id AND m.department_id = s.id)) ORDER BY p.last_name, p.first_name;
SELECT name, price FROM dishes WHERE available = 0 ORDER BY price DESC, name;
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2024-07-01' AND signup_date < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT p.name, p.price FROM dishes p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Wok dishes' ORDER BY p.price, p.name;
SELECT id, rating, customer_id FROM reviews WHERE comment IS NULL ORDER BY rating DESC, id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM waiters WHERE hire_date > '2020-01-01' ORDER BY hire_date, last_name, first_name;
SELECT id, order_date, order_time FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled' ORDER BY order_date, order_time, id;
SELECT name, stock, alert_threshold FROM ingredients WHERE stock < alert_threshold ORDER BY alert_threshold - stock, name;
SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, cl.email FROM customers cl LEFT JOIN orders c ON c.customer_id = cl.id WHERE c.id IS NULL ORDER BY cl.last_name, cl.first_name;
SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.hire_date FROM waiters s LEFT JOIN orders c ON c.waiter_id = s.id WHERE c.id IS NULL ORDER BY s.last_name, s.first_name;
SELECT c.id, c.order_date, c.status FROM orders c LEFT JOIN reviews a ON a.order_id = c.id WHERE a.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.order_date, c.id;

SELECT cat.name AS category, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_lines l JOIN orders c ON c.id = l.order_id JOIN dishes p ON p.id = l.dish_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cat.id, cat.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, cat.name;

SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(c.id) AS order_count FROM waiters s LEFT JOIN orders c ON c.waiter_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, s.last_name, s.first_name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT c.id AS order_id, c.customer_id, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total FROM orders c JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id WHERE c.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_id) SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS avg_basket FROM totals t JOIN customers cl ON cl.id = t.customer_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name ORDER BY avg_basket DESC, cl.last_name, cl.first_name;

SELECT p.name, SUM(l.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_lines l JOIN orders c ON c.id = l.order_id JOIN dishes p ON p.id = l.dish_id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.name LIMIT 5;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers cl JOIN orders c ON c.customer_id = cl.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name HAVING SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) > 100 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, cl.last_name, cl.first_name;

SELECT i.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pi.dish_id) AS dish_count FROM ingredients i JOIN dish_ingredients pi ON pi.ingredient_id = i.id GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pi.dish_id) > 3 ORDER BY dish_count DESC, i.name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT c.id, c.customer_id, c.party_size, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total FROM orders c JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_id, c.party_size) SELECT t.id, COALESCE(cl.first_name, 'Anonymous') AS first_name, COALESCE(cl.last_name, '') AS last_name, t.party_size, t.total FROM totals t LEFT JOIN customers cl ON cl.id = t.customer_id WHERE t.total > 50 ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.id;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cat.id) AS category_count FROM customers cl JOIN orders c ON c.customer_id = cl.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id JOIN dishes p ON p.id = l.dish_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cat.id) >= 3 ORDER BY category_count DESC, cl.last_name, cl.first_name;
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews), 1) AS percentage FROM reviews GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC;

SELECT p.name, cat.name AS category, p.price FROM dishes p JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_lines l JOIN orders c ON c.id = l.order_id WHERE l.dish_id = p.id AND c.status <> 'Cancelled') ORDER BY cat.name, p.name;

SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM waiters s JOIN orders c ON c.waiter_id = s.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, s.last_name, s.first_name LIMIT 3;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) DESC) AS rank FROM customers cl JOIN orders c ON c.customer_id = cl.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name ORDER BY rank, cl.last_name, cl.first_name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT c.id AS order_id, c.customer_id, c.order_date, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total FROM orders c JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.customer_id, c.order_date) SELECT t.order_date, t.total, LAG(t.total) OVER (ORDER BY t.order_date, t.order_id) AS previous_total, t.total - LAG(t.total) OVER (ORDER BY t.order_date, t.order_id) AS difference FROM totals t JOIN customers cl ON cl.id = t.customer_id WHERE cl.first_name = 'Camille' AND cl.last_name = 'Moreau' ORDER BY t.order_date, t.order_id;

WITH totals AS (SELECT cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total FROM customers cl JOIN orders c ON c.customer_id = cl.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name), average AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS value FROM totals) SELECT t.first_name, t.last_name, t.total, ROUND(t.total - m.value, 2) AS gap_from_average FROM totals t CROSS JOIN average m WHERE t.total > m.value ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.last_name, t.first_name;

SELECT cat.name AS category, p.name AS dish, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cat.id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) DESC) AS rank FROM categories cat JOIN dishes p ON p.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.dish_id = p.id JOIN orders c ON c.id = l.order_id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cat.id, cat.name, p.id, p.name ORDER BY cat.name, rank, p.name;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%m', c.order_date)) AS month_count FROM customers cl JOIN orders c ON c.customer_id = cl.id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' AND c.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND c.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%m', c.order_date)) >= 3 ORDER BY cl.last_name, cl.first_name;

WITH sales AS (SELECT cat.id AS category_id, cat.name AS category, p.id AS dish_id, p.name AS dish, SUM(l.quantity) AS quantity FROM categories cat JOIN dishes p ON p.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.dish_id = p.id JOIN orders c ON c.id = l.order_id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cat.id, cat.name, p.id, p.name), averages AS (SELECT category_id, AVG(quantity) AS average FROM sales GROUP BY category_id) SELECT v.category, v.dish, v.quantity, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS category_average FROM sales v JOIN averages m ON m.category_id = v.category_id WHERE v.quantity > m.average ORDER BY v.category, v.quantity DESC, v.dish;

SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price), 0) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price), 0) DESC) AS rank FROM waiters s LEFT JOIN orders c ON c.waiter_id = s.id AND c.status <> 'Cancelled' LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id GROUP BY s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY rank, s.last_name, s.first_name;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, p.name AS dish, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS order_count FROM customers cl JOIN orders c ON c.customer_id = cl.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id JOIN dishes p ON p.id = l.dish_id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name, p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 2 ORDER BY order_count DESC, cl.last_name, cl.first_name, p.name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name, substr(cl.email, -2) AS domain, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) AS total FROM customers cl JOIN orders c ON c.customer_id = cl.id JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = c.id WHERE c.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name, substr(cl.email, -2)), averages AS (SELECT domain, AVG(total) AS average FROM totals GROUP BY domain) SELECT t.domain, t.first_name, t.last_name, t.total, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS domain_average FROM totals t JOIN averages m ON m.domain = t.domain WHERE t.total > m.average ORDER BY t.domain, t.total DESC, t.last_name, t.first_name;
SELECT name, texture, price_per_kg FROM cheeses WHERE available = 1 ORDER BY price_per_kg, name;
SELECT name, region, country FROM producers ORDER BY region, name;
SELECT name, price_per_kg FROM cheeses WHERE texture = 'Blue' ORDER BY price_per_kg DESC, name;
SELECT first_name, last_name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Paris' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT id, sale_date, total_price FROM sales WHERE total_price > 15 ORDER BY sale_date DESC, id;
SELECT customer_id, cheese_id, rating FROM tastings WHERE rating >= 4 ORDER BY rating DESC, cheese_id, customer_id;
SELECT batch_number, weight_kg, production_date FROM batches WHERE weight_kg >= 3 ORDER BY weight_kg DESC, batch_number;
SELECT id, sale_date, total_price FROM sales WHERE sale_date >= '2024-10-01' ORDER BY sale_date, id;
SELECT DISTINCT texture FROM cheeses ORDER BY texture;

SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(v.id) AS sale_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales v ON v.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY sale_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name, c.id;

SELECT p.region, ROUND(SUM(v.total_price), 2) AS revenue FROM sales v JOIN batches l ON l.id = v.batch_id JOIN cheeses f ON f.id = l.cheese_id JOIN producers p ON p.id = f.producer_id GROUP BY p.region ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.region;
SELECT f.name, ROUND(AVG(d.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM cheeses f JOIN tastings d ON d.cheese_id = f.id GROUP BY f.id, f.name HAVING AVG(d.rating) > 4 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, f.name;
SELECT p.name, COUNT(f.id) AS cheese_count FROM producers p JOIN cheeses f ON f.producer_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(f.id) > 2 ORDER BY cheese_count DESC, p.name;

SELECT f.name, COUNT(v.id) AS sale_count FROM cheeses f JOIN batches l ON l.cheese_id = f.id JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id GROUP BY f.id, f.name HAVING COUNT(v.id) > 2 ORDER BY sale_count DESC, f.name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(SUM(v.total_price), 2) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN sales v ON v.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(v.total_price) > 50 ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;
SELECT id, sale_date, total_price FROM sales WHERE total_price > (SELECT AVG(total_price) FROM sales) ORDER BY total_price DESC, id;

SELECT f.texture, ROUND(SUM(v.quantity_kg), 2) AS weight_sold, ROUND(SUM(v.total_price), 2) AS revenue FROM cheeses f JOIN batches l ON l.cheese_id = f.id JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id GROUP BY f.texture ORDER BY revenue DESC, f.texture;
SELECT p.name, COUNT(f.id) AS cheese_count FROM producers p LEFT JOIN cheeses f ON f.producer_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.name, p.id;
SELECT f.id, f.name FROM cheeses f LEFT JOIN tastings d ON d.cheese_id = f.id WHERE d.id IS NULL ORDER BY f.id;
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS tasting_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tastings), 1) AS percentage FROM tastings GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC;

WITH cheese_revenue AS (SELECT p.region, f.id, f.name, SUM(v.total_price) AS revenue FROM producers p JOIN cheeses f ON f.producer_id = p.id JOIN batches l ON l.cheese_id = f.id JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id GROUP BY p.region, f.id, f.name), ranking AS (SELECT region, name, revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rank FROM cheese_revenue) SELECT region, name, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM ranking WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY region, revenue DESC, name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.city, SUM(v.total_price) AS total FROM customers c JOIN sales v ON v.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.city), averages AS (SELECT city, AVG(total) AS average FROM totals GROUP BY city) SELECT t.city, t.first_name, t.last_name, ROUND(t.total, 2) AS total_spent, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS city_average FROM totals t JOIN averages m ON m.city = t.city WHERE t.total > m.average ORDER BY t.city, t.total DESC, t.last_name, t.first_name;

WITH cheese_revenue AS (SELECT f.id, f.name, SUM(v.total_price) AS total FROM cheeses f JOIN batches l ON l.cheese_id = f.id JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id GROUP BY f.id, f.name) SELECT name, ROUND(total, 2) AS revenue FROM cheese_revenue WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM cheese_revenue) ORDER BY revenue DESC, name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(v.total_price) AS revenue FROM producers p JOIN cheeses f ON f.producer_id = p.id JOIN batches l ON l.cheese_id = f.id JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name) SELECT name, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM totals WHERE revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM totals) ORDER BY revenue DESC, name;

SELECT f.name, ROUND(SUM(v.quantity_kg), 2) AS quantity_sold, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.quantity_kg) DESC) AS rank FROM cheeses f JOIN batches l ON l.cheese_id = f.id JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id GROUP BY f.id, f.name ORDER BY rank, f.name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN sales v ON v.customer_id = c.id JOIN batches l ON l.id = v.batch_id JOIN cheeses f ON f.id = l.cheese_id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.texture) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT texture) FROM cheeses) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, f.name AS cheese, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS sale_count FROM customers c JOIN sales v ON v.customer_id = c.id JOIN batches l ON l.id = v.batch_id JOIN cheeses f ON f.id = l.cheese_id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, f.id, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) > 2 ORDER BY sale_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name, f.name;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL THEN f.id END) AS cheeses_sold FROM cheeses f LEFT JOIN batches l ON l.cheese_id = f.id LEFT JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.texture) AS type_count FROM customers c JOIN sales v ON v.customer_id = c.id JOIN batches l ON l.id = v.batch_id JOIN cheeses f ON f.id = l.cheese_id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.texture) > 2 ORDER BY type_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;

WITH prices AS (SELECT f.id, f.name, SUM(v.total_price) / SUM(v.quantity_kg) AS avg_price_per_kg FROM cheeses f JOIN batches l ON l.cheese_id = f.id JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id GROUP BY f.id, f.name) SELECT name, ROUND(avg_price_per_kg, 2) AS avg_price_per_kg FROM prices WHERE avg_price_per_kg > (SELECT SUM(total_price) / SUM(quantity_kg) FROM sales) ORDER BY avg_price_per_kg DESC, name;
SELECT id, booking_date, status FROM bookings WHERE status = 'Cancelled' ORDER BY booking_date, id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM customers WHERE city = 'Lyon' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT c.name AS tour, d.country, c.base_price FROM tours c JOIN destinations d ON d.id = c.destination_id WHERE d.continent = 'Asia' ORDER BY c.base_price, c.name;
SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM guides WHERE language = 'French' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT id, amount, payment_date FROM payments WHERE status = 'Pending' ORDER BY amount DESC, id;
SELECT name, duration_days, base_price FROM tours WHERE duration_days > 10 ORDER BY duration_days DESC, name;
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.city FROM customers c LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;
SELECT g.first_name, g.last_name, g.language FROM guides g LEFT JOIN guide_assignments a ON a.guide_id = g.id WHERE a.id IS NULL ORDER BY g.last_name, g.first_name;
SELECT id, rating, customer_id FROM reviews WHERE comment IS NULL ORDER BY rating DESC, id;

SELECT c.name AS tour, d.name AS destination, c.base_price FROM tours c JOIN destinations d ON d.id = c.destination_id LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.tour_id = c.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.base_price DESC, c.name;

SELECT d.name AS destination, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN bookings r ON r.id = p.booking_id JOIN tours ci ON ci.id = r.tour_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY d.id, d.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, d.name;
SELECT c.name AS tour, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count FROM tours c LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.tour_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY booking_count DESC, c.name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT r.id AS booking_id, r.customer_id, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total FROM bookings r LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id AND p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY r.id, r.customer_id) SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(AVG(t.total), 2) AS avg_basket FROM totals t JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY avg_basket DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;

WITH per_booking AS (SELECT r.id, r.tour_id, r.traveler_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'Paid' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM bookings r LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE r.status <> 'Cancelled' GROUP BY r.id, r.tour_id, r.traveler_count) SELECT c.name AS tour, SUM(pr.traveler_count) AS traveler_count, ROUND(SUM(pr.revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM per_booking pr JOIN tours c ON c.id = pr.tour_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY traveler_count DESC, revenue DESC, c.name LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN bookings r ON r.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(p.amount) > 3000 ORDER BY total_paid DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;

SELECT g.first_name, g.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.tour_id) AS tour_count FROM guides g JOIN guide_assignments a ON a.guide_id = g.id GROUP BY g.id, g.first_name, g.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.tour_id) > 2 ORDER BY tour_count DESC, g.last_name, g.first_name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT r.id, r.customer_id, r.tour_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM bookings r JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY r.id, r.customer_id, r.tour_id) SELECT t.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name, ci.name AS tour, ROUND(t.total, 2) AS total FROM totals t JOIN customers cl ON cl.id = t.customer_id JOIN tours ci ON ci.id = t.tour_id WHERE t.total > 5000 ORDER BY t.total DESC, t.id;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS destination_count FROM customers cl JOIN bookings r ON r.customer_id = cl.id JOIN tours ci ON ci.id = r.tour_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) >= 2 ORDER BY destination_count DESC, cl.last_name, cl.first_name;
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews), 1) AS percentage FROM reviews GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC;

SELECT ci.name AS tour, d.name AS destination, ci.base_price FROM tours ci JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id LEFT JOIN reviews a ON a.tour_id = ci.id WHERE a.id IS NULL ORDER BY ci.base_price DESC, ci.name;

SELECT d.name AS destination, d.country, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM payments p JOIN bookings r ON r.id = p.booking_id JOIN tours ci ON ci.id = r.tour_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, d.name LIMIT 3;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC) AS rank FROM customers cl JOIN bookings r ON r.customer_id = cl.id JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name ORDER BY rank, cl.last_name, cl.first_name, cl.id;

WITH totals AS (SELECT r.id, r.customer_id, r.booking_date, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM bookings r JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY r.id, r.customer_id, r.booking_date) SELECT t.booking_date, t.total, LAG(t.total) OVER (ORDER BY t.booking_date, t.id) AS previous_total, t.total - LAG(t.total) OVER (ORDER BY t.booking_date, t.id) AS difference FROM totals t JOIN customers cl ON cl.id = t.customer_id WHERE cl.first_name = 'Camille' AND cl.last_name = 'Moreau' ORDER BY t.booking_date, t.id;

WITH totals AS (SELECT cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM customers cl JOIN bookings r ON r.customer_id = cl.id JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name) SELECT first_name, last_name, ROUND(total, 2) AS total_paid, ROUND(total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM totals), 2) AS gap_from_average FROM totals WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM totals) ORDER BY total DESC, last_name, first_name;

SELECT d.name AS destination, ci.name AS tour, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.id ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC) AS rank FROM destinations d JOIN tours ci ON ci.destination_id = d.id JOIN bookings r ON r.tour_id = ci.id JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY d.id, d.name, ci.id, ci.name ORDER BY d.name, rank, ci.name;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.continent) AS continent_count FROM customers cl JOIN bookings r ON r.customer_id = cl.id JOIN tours ci ON ci.id = r.tour_id JOIN destinations d ON d.id = ci.destination_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.continent) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT continent) FROM destinations) ORDER BY cl.last_name, cl.first_name;

WITH volumes AS (SELECT d.id AS destination_id, d.name AS destination, ci.id AS tour_id, ci.name AS tour, SUM(r.traveler_count) AS traveler_count FROM destinations d JOIN tours ci ON ci.destination_id = d.id JOIN bookings r ON r.tour_id = ci.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name, ci.id, ci.name), averages AS (SELECT destination_id, AVG(traveler_count) AS average FROM volumes GROUP BY destination_id) SELECT v.destination, v.tour, v.traveler_count, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS destination_average FROM volumes v JOIN averages m ON m.destination_id = v.destination_id WHERE v.traveler_count > m.average ORDER BY v.destination, v.traveler_count DESC, v.tour;

SELECT g.first_name, g.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.tour_id) AS tour_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.tour_id) DESC) AS rank FROM guides g LEFT JOIN guide_assignments a ON a.guide_id = g.id GROUP BY g.id, g.first_name, g.last_name ORDER BY rank, g.last_name, g.first_name;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, ci.name AS tour, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS booking_count FROM customers cl JOIN bookings r ON r.customer_id = cl.id JOIN tours ci ON ci.id = r.tour_id GROUP BY cl.id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name, ci.id, ci.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) > 2 ORDER BY booking_count DESC, cl.last_name, cl.first_name, ci.name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT cl.id, cl.city, cl.first_name, cl.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM customers cl JOIN bookings r ON r.customer_id = cl.id JOIN payments p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE p.status = 'Paid' GROUP BY cl.id, cl.city, cl.first_name, cl.last_name), averages AS (SELECT city, AVG(total) AS average FROM totals GROUP BY city) SELECT t.city, t.first_name, t.last_name, ROUND(t.total, 2) AS total_paid, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS city_average FROM totals t JOIN averages m ON m.city = t.city WHERE t.total > m.average ORDER BY t.city, t.total DESC, t.last_name, t.first_name;
SELECT title, start_date, budget FROM projects WHERE end_date IS NULL ORDER BY start_date, title;
SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM researchers WHERE position = 'Director' ORDER BY last_name, first_name;
SELECT name, experiment_date, duration_hours FROM experiments WHERE status = 'Planned' ORDER BY experiment_date, name;
SELECT r.id, r.measure, e.name AS experiment FROM results r JOIN experiments e ON e.id = r.experiment_id WHERE r.value IS NULL ORDER BY r.id;
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.position FROM researchers c JOIN teams e ON e.id = c.team_id WHERE e.field = 'Biology' ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;
SELECT title, journal, project_id FROM publications WHERE publication_date IS NULL ORDER BY title;
SELECT sample_code, quantity_mg, collection_date FROM samples WHERE sample_type = 'Blood' ORDER BY collection_date, sample_code;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.position FROM researchers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM researcher_assignments a JOIN publications pub ON pub.project_id = a.project_id WHERE a.researcher_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;
SELECT title, budget, status FROM projects WHERE budget > 300000 ORDER BY budget DESC, title;

SELECT e.name AS experiment, e.status, p.title AS project FROM experiments e JOIN projects p ON p.id = e.project_id LEFT JOIN samples s ON s.experiment_id = e.id WHERE s.id IS NULL ORDER BY e.name, e.id;
SELECT p.title, COUNT(e.id) AS experiment_count FROM projects p LEFT JOIN experiments e ON e.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.title ORDER BY experiment_count DESC, p.title;
SELECT e.name AS team, SUM(p.budget) AS total_budget FROM teams e JOIN projects p ON p.team_id = e.id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY total_budget DESC, e.name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(e.id) AS experiment_count FROM researchers c JOIN experiments e ON e.researcher_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(e.id) > 2 ORDER BY experiment_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;

SELECT e.name AS team, COUNT(DISTINCT pub.id) AS publication_count FROM teams e LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.team_id = e.id LEFT JOIN publications pub ON pub.project_id = p.id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY publication_count DESC, e.name;
SELECT p.title, p.budget, p.status FROM projects p LEFT JOIN publications pub ON pub.project_id = p.id WHERE pub.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.budget DESC, p.title;
SELECT sample_type, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, SUM(quantity_mg) AS total_quantity FROM samples GROUP BY sample_type ORDER BY sample_count DESC, sample_type;

SELECT p.title, COUNT(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.validated = 1) AS validated_count FROM projects p LEFT JOIN experiments e ON e.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN results r ON r.experiment_id = e.id GROUP BY p.id, p.title ORDER BY validated_count DESC, p.title;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.project_id) AS project_count FROM researchers c JOIN researcher_assignments a ON a.researcher_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.project_id) > 2 ORDER BY project_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;

SELECT CASE WHEN validated = 1 THEN 'Validated' ELSE 'Pending' END AS validation_status, COUNT(*) AS result_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results), 1) AS percentage FROM results GROUP BY validation_status ORDER BY result_count DESC, validation_status;

WITH stats AS (SELECT e.id AS team_id, e.name AS team, p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.budget FROM teams e JOIN projects p ON p.team_id = e.id), averages AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(budget) AS average FROM stats GROUP BY team_id) SELECT s.team, s.title, s.budget, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS team_average FROM stats s JOIN averages m ON m.team_id = s.team_id WHERE s.budget > m.average ORDER BY s.team, s.budget DESC, s.title;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(e.id) AS experiment_count FROM researchers c JOIN experiments e ON e.researcher_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY experiment_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name LIMIT 5;
SELECT title, budget, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY budget DESC) AS rank FROM projects ORDER BY rank, title;

SELECT e.experiment_date, e.duration_hours, LAG(e.duration_hours) OVER (ORDER BY e.experiment_date, e.id) AS previous_duration, e.duration_hours - LAG(e.duration_hours) OVER (ORDER BY e.experiment_date, e.id) AS difference FROM experiments e JOIN researchers c ON c.id = e.researcher_id WHERE c.first_name = 'Sophie' AND c.last_name = 'Martin' ORDER BY e.experiment_date, e.id;

WITH budgets AS (SELECT e.id AS team_id, e.name AS team, c.id AS researcher_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.budget) AS total_budget FROM teams e JOIN researchers c ON c.team_id = e.id JOIN researcher_assignments a ON a.researcher_id = c.id JOIN projects p ON p.id = a.project_id GROUP BY e.id, e.name, c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name), averages AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(total_budget) AS average FROM budgets GROUP BY team_id) SELECT b.team, b.first_name, b.last_name, b.total_budget, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS team_average FROM budgets b JOIN averages m ON m.team_id = b.team_id WHERE b.total_budget > m.average ORDER BY b.team, b.total_budget DESC, b.last_name, b.first_name;

SELECT p.title, COUNT(pub.id) AS publication_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(pub.id) DESC) AS rank FROM projects p LEFT JOIN publications pub ON pub.project_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.title ORDER BY rank, p.title;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM researchers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publications team_pub JOIN projects team_p ON team_p.id = team_pub.project_id WHERE team_p.team_id = c.team_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM researcher_assignments a WHERE a.researcher_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publications pub JOIN projects p ON p.id = pub.project_id WHERE p.team_id = c.team_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM researcher_assignments a2 JOIN publications pub2 ON pub2.project_id = a2.project_id WHERE a2.researcher_id = c.id AND pub2.journal = pub.journal)) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;

SELECT e.name AS team, p.title, p.start_date, p.budget, SUM(p.budget) OVER (PARTITION BY e.id ORDER BY p.start_date, p.id) AS running_budget FROM projects p JOIN teams e ON e.id = p.team_id ORDER BY e.name, p.start_date;

SELECT team, title, start_date FROM (SELECT e.name AS team, p.title, p.start_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.id ORDER BY p.start_date, p.id) AS rn FROM teams e JOIN projects p ON p.team_id = e.id) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY start_date;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.project_id) AS project_count FROM researchers c JOIN experiments e ON e.researcher_id = c.id JOIN results r ON r.experiment_id = e.id WHERE r.validated = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.project_id) > 1 ORDER BY project_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;

SELECT project, experiment, duration_hours FROM (SELECT p.title AS project, x.name AS experiment, x.duration_hours, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY x.duration_hours DESC) AS rg FROM projects p JOIN experiments x ON x.project_id = p.id) WHERE rg = 1 ORDER BY project, experiment;

SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.enclosure_id) AS enclosure_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.enclosure_id) DESC) AS rank FROM keepers s LEFT JOIN keeper_assignments a ON a.keeper_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY rank, s.last_name, s.first_name, s.id;

SELECT a.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.meal_type) AS type_count, COUNT(r.id) AS meal_count FROM animals a JOIN meals r ON r.animal_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.meal_type) > 1 ORDER BY type_count DESC, a.name, a.id;

WITH totals AS (SELECT v.id, v.city, v.first_name, v.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(b.price), 0) AS total FROM visitors v LEFT JOIN tickets b ON b.visitor_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.city, v.first_name, v.last_name), averages AS (SELECT city, AVG(total) AS average FROM totals GROUP BY city) SELECT t.city, t.first_name, t.last_name, t.total, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS city_average FROM totals t JOIN averages m ON m.city = t.city WHERE t.total > m.average ORDER BY t.city, t.total DESC, t.last_name, t.first_name;
SELECT name, sex, arrival_date FROM animals WHERE weight_kg IS NULL ORDER BY arrival_date, name, id;

SELECT a.name, en.name AS enclosures, a.birth_date FROM animals a JOIN species e ON e.id = a.species_id JOIN enclosures en ON en.id = a.enclosure_id WHERE e.common_name = 'Lion' ORDER BY a.birth_date, a.name, a.id;
SELECT name, area_m2, capacity FROM enclosures WHERE type = 'Savanna' ORDER BY area_m2 DESC, name, id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM keepers WHERE specialty = 'Reptiles' ORDER BY last_name, first_name, id;
SELECT id, meal_date, meal_time, quantity_kg FROM meals WHERE keeper_id IS NULL ORDER BY meal_date, meal_time, id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM visitors WHERE city = 'Paris' ORDER BY last_name, first_name, id;
SELECT id, visit_date, price FROM tickets WHERE ticket_type = 'Family' ORDER BY visit_date, id;
SELECT v.first_name, v.last_name, v.email FROM visitors v LEFT JOIN tickets b ON b.visitor_id = v.id WHERE b.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.last_name, v.first_name, v.id;
SELECT id, rating, visitor_id FROM reviews WHERE comment IS NULL ORDER BY rating DESC, id;
SELECT a.name, e.common_name, a.weight_kg FROM animals a JOIN species e ON e.id = a.species_id JOIN enclosures en ON en.id = a.enclosure_id WHERE en.name = 'African Plain' ORDER BY a.name, a.id;

SELECT en.name, en.capacity, COUNT(a.id) AS animal_count FROM enclosures en LEFT JOIN animals a ON a.enclosure_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.name, en.capacity ORDER BY animal_count DESC, en.name, en.id;
SELECT a.name, SUM(r.quantity_kg) AS total_quantity, COUNT(r.id) AS meal_count FROM animals a JOIN meals r ON r.animal_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, a.name, a.id;
SELECT ticket_type, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM tickets GROUP BY ticket_type ORDER BY revenue DESC, ticket_type;

SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.enclosure_id) AS enclosure_count FROM keepers s LEFT JOIN keeper_assignments a ON a.keeper_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY enclosure_count DESC, s.last_name, s.first_name, s.id;
SELECT a.name, COUNT(r.id) AS meal_count FROM animals a JOIN meals r ON r.animal_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.name HAVING COUNT(r.id) > 1 ORDER BY meal_count DESC, a.name, a.id;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', visit_date) AS month, ticket_type, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count FROM tickets GROUP BY month, ticket_type ORDER BY month, ticket_type;

SELECT v.first_name, v.last_name, ROUND(AVG(a.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM visitors v JOIN reviews a ON a.visitor_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.first_name, v.last_name HAVING AVG(a.rating) > 4 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, v.last_name, v.first_name, v.id;

SELECT en.name, en.capacity, COUNT(a.id) AS animal_count FROM enclosures en JOIN animals a ON a.enclosure_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.name, en.capacity HAVING en.capacity - COUNT(a.id) <= 4 ORDER BY en.capacity - COUNT(a.id), en.name, en.id;

SELECT a.name, e.common_name, en.name AS enclosures FROM animals a JOIN species e ON e.id = a.species_id JOIN enclosures en ON en.id = a.enclosure_id LEFT JOIN meals r ON r.animal_id = a.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.name, a.id;
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews), 1) AS percentage FROM reviews GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC;
SELECT en.name, COUNT(a.id) AS animal_count FROM enclosures en LEFT JOIN animals a ON a.enclosure_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.name ORDER BY animal_count DESC, en.name, en.id LIMIT 3;

SELECT en.name, COUNT(a.id) AS animal_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(a.id) DESC) AS rank FROM enclosures en LEFT JOIN animals a ON a.enclosure_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.name ORDER BY rank, en.name, en.id;

SELECT r.meal_date, r.quantity_kg, LAG(r.quantity_kg) OVER (ORDER BY r.meal_date, r.meal_time, r.id) AS previous_quantity, r.quantity_kg - LAG(r.quantity_kg) OVER (ORDER BY r.meal_date, r.meal_time, r.id) AS difference FROM meals r JOIN animals a ON a.id = r.animal_id WHERE a.name = 'Simba' ORDER BY r.meal_date, r.meal_time, r.id;

WITH stats AS (SELECT s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(r.id) AS meal_count FROM keepers s LEFT JOIN meals r ON r.keeper_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name) SELECT first_name, last_name, meal_count, ROUND((SELECT AVG(meal_count) FROM stats), 2) AS overall_average FROM stats WHERE meal_count > (SELECT AVG(meal_count) FROM stats) ORDER BY meal_count DESC, last_name, first_name, id;

SELECT e.common_name, COUNT(a.id) AS animal_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(a.id) DESC) AS rank FROM species e LEFT JOIN animals a ON a.species_id = e.id GROUP BY e.id, e.common_name ORDER BY rank, e.common_name, e.id;

SELECT v.first_name, v.last_name FROM visitors v WHERE NOT (v.first_name = 'Manon' AND v.last_name = 'Lambert') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets r JOIN visitors ref ON ref.id = r.visitor_id WHERE ref.first_name = 'Manon' AND ref.last_name = 'Lambert' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets b WHERE b.visitor_id = v.id AND b.ticket_type = r.ticket_type)) ORDER BY v.last_name, v.first_name, v.id;

WITH stats AS (SELECT en.id, en.name, en.type, COUNT(a.id) AS animal_count FROM enclosures en LEFT JOIN animals a ON a.enclosure_id = en.id GROUP BY en.id, en.name, en.type), averages AS (SELECT type, AVG(animal_count) AS average FROM stats GROUP BY type) SELECT s.type, s.name, s.animal_count, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS type_average FROM stats s JOIN averages m ON m.type = s.type WHERE s.animal_count > m.average ORDER BY s.type, s.animal_count DESC, s.name, s.id;
SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM members a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions ab WHERE ab.member_id = a.id AND ab.end_date IS NULL) ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, a.id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM coaches WHERE specialty = 'Yoga' ORDER BY last_name, first_name, id;
SELECT name, max_capacity, duration_min, level FROM classes WHERE max_capacity > 15 ORDER BY max_capacity DESC, name, id;
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.specialty FROM coaches c LEFT JOIN classes co ON co.coach_id = c.id WHERE co.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name, c.id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, email FROM members WHERE birth_date > '2000-01-01' ORDER BY birth_date, last_name, first_name, id;
SELECT name, area_m2, type FROM rooms WHERE type = 'Group classes' ORDER BY area_m2 DESC, name, id;
SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, a.email FROM members a LEFT JOIN class_bookings i ON i.member_id = a.id WHERE i.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, a.id;
SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, ab.type, ab.price FROM subscriptions ab JOIN members a ON a.id = ab.member_id WHERE ab.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, ab.type, ab.id;
SELECT name, duration_min, max_capacity FROM classes WHERE level = 'Advanced' ORDER BY duration_min DESC, name, id;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM members a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_bookings i JOIN schedule p ON p.id = i.schedule_id WHERE i.member_id = a.id AND p.weekday = 'Monday') ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, a.id;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(i.id) AS booking_count FROM classes c LEFT JOIN schedule p ON p.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN class_bookings i ON i.schedule_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY booking_count DESC, c.name, c.id;
SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS subscription_count, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM subscriptions GROUP BY type ORDER BY revenue DESC, type;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.schedule_id) AS slot_count FROM members a JOIN class_bookings i ON i.member_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.schedule_id) > 2 ORDER BY slot_count DESC, a.last_name, a.first_name, a.id;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(i.id) AS booked_count, SUM(CASE WHEN i.attended THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attended_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.attended THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(i.id), 1) AS attendance_rate_pct FROM classes c JOIN schedule p ON p.class_id = c.id JOIN class_bookings i ON i.schedule_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY attendance_rate_pct DESC, c.name, c.id;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.id) AS class_count FROM coaches c LEFT JOIN classes co ON co.coach_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY class_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name, c.id;

SELECT c.name, p.weekday, p.start_time, c.max_capacity, COUNT(i.id) AS booked_count FROM classes c JOIN schedule p ON p.class_id = c.id JOIN class_bookings i ON i.schedule_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, c.id, c.name, p.weekday, p.start_time, c.max_capacity HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= c.max_capacity ORDER BY COUNT(i.id) - c.max_capacity DESC, c.name, p.weekday, p.start_time, p.id;
SELECT type, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count FROM subscriptions WHERE end_date IS NULL GROUP BY type ORDER BY member_count DESC, type;

SELECT DISTINCT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM members a JOIN class_bookings i ON i.member_id = a.id JOIN schedule p ON p.id = i.schedule_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = p.class_id WHERE c.name LIKE '%Yoga%' AND i.attended = TRUE ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name;

SELECT c.name, p.weekday, p.start_time FROM classes c JOIN schedule p ON p.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN class_bookings i ON i.schedule_id = p.id AND i.attended = FALSE WHERE i.id IS NULL ORDER BY CASE p.weekday WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7 END, p.start_time, c.name, p.id;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, ab.end_date FROM members a JOIN subscriptions ab ON ab.member_id = a.id WHERE ab.end_date IS NOT NULL AND ab.end_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY ab.end_date, a.last_name, a.first_name, ab.id;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(i.id) AS booking_count FROM coaches c JOIN classes co ON co.coach_id = c.id JOIN schedule p ON p.class_id = co.id JOIN class_bookings i ON i.schedule_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY booking_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name, c.id LIMIT 3;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.schedule_id) AS slot_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT i.schedule_id) DESC) AS rank FROM members a JOIN class_bookings i ON i.member_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY rank, a.last_name, a.first_name, a.id;

WITH stats AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', start_date) AS month, SUM(price) AS amount FROM subscriptions GROUP BY month) SELECT month, amount, LAG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_amount, amount - LAG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS difference FROM stats ORDER BY month;

WITH stats AS (SELECT a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.schedule_id) AS slot_count FROM members a JOIN class_bookings i ON i.member_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name) SELECT first_name, last_name, slot_count, ROUND(slot_count - (SELECT AVG(slot_count) FROM stats), 2) AS diff_from_average FROM stats WHERE slot_count > (SELECT AVG(slot_count) FROM stats) ORDER BY slot_count DESC, last_name, first_name, id;

SELECT c.name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.attended THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(i.id), 1) AS attendance_rate_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.attended THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(i.id) DESC) AS rank FROM classes c JOIN schedule p ON p.class_id = c.id JOIN class_bookings i ON i.schedule_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY rank, c.name, c.id;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, co.first_name || ' ' || co.last_name AS coach FROM members a JOIN class_bookings i ON i.member_id = a.id JOIN schedule p ON p.id = i.schedule_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = p.class_id JOIN coaches co ON co.id = c.coach_id WHERE i.attended = TRUE GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name, co.id, co.first_name, co.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.id) FROM classes c2 WHERE c2.coach_id = co.id) ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, co.last_name, co.first_name;

WITH stats AS (SELECT co.id AS coach_id, co.first_name || ' ' || co.last_name AS coach, c.id AS class_id, c.name AS classes, COUNT(i.id) AS booked_count FROM coaches co JOIN classes c ON c.coach_id = co.id LEFT JOIN schedule p ON p.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN class_bookings i ON i.schedule_id = p.id GROUP BY co.id, co.first_name, co.last_name, c.id, c.name), averages AS (SELECT coach_id, AVG(booked_count) AS average FROM stats GROUP BY coach_id) SELECT s.coach, s.classes, s.booked_count, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS coach_average FROM stats s JOIN averages m ON m.coach_id = s.coach_id WHERE s.booked_count > m.average ORDER BY s.coach, s.booked_count DESC, s.classes, s.class_id;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(i.id) AS booked_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(i.id) DESC) AS rank FROM coaches c LEFT JOIN classes co ON co.coach_id = c.id LEFT JOIN schedule p ON p.class_id = co.id LEFT JOIN class_bookings i ON i.schedule_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY rank, c.last_name, c.first_name, c.id;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.room_id) AS room_count FROM members a JOIN class_bookings i ON i.member_id = a.id JOIN schedule p ON p.id = i.schedule_id WHERE i.attended = TRUE GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.room_id) >= 2 ORDER BY room_count DESC, a.last_name, a.first_name, a.id;

WITH totals AS (SELECT a.id, ab.type, a.first_name, a.last_name, SUM(ab.price) AS total FROM members a JOIN subscriptions ab ON ab.member_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, ab.type, a.first_name, a.last_name), averages AS (SELECT type, AVG(total) AS average FROM totals GROUP BY type) SELECT t.type, t.first_name, t.last_name, t.total, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS plan_average FROM totals t JOIN averages m ON m.type = t.type WHERE t.total > m.average ORDER BY t.type, t.total DESC, t.last_name, t.first_name, t.id;
SELECT p.name, p.length_m, r.name AS lift FROM slopes p JOIN lifts r ON r.id = p.lift_id WHERE p.color = 'Black' AND p.status = 'Open' ORDER BY p.length_m DESC, p.name;
SELECT name, type, top_altitude - base_altitude AS vertical_drop FROM lifts ORDER BY vertical_drop DESC, name LIMIT 3;
SELECT id, rate, price, start_date FROM passes WHERE customer_id IS NULL ORDER BY start_date, id;
SELECT DISTINCT r.name, r.type FROM lift_rides p JOIN lifts r ON r.id = p.lift_id WHERE p.ride_date = '2025-02-18' ORDER BY r.name;
SELECT day_date, resort_status, closure_reason, wind_kmh FROM weather WHERE resort_status <> 'Fully open' ORDER BY day_date;
SELECT first_name || ' ' || UPPER(last_name) AS badge, specialty FROM instructors ORDER BY last_name;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ride_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pass_id) AS pass_count FROM lift_rides WHERE ride_date = '2025-02-15';
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, f.price FROM passes f JOIN customers c ON c.id = f.customer_id WHERE f.type = 'Season' ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;
SELECT name, ROUND(vertical_drop_m * 100.0 / length_m, 1) AS slope_pct FROM slopes WHERE color = 'Red' ORDER BY slope_pct DESC, name;

SELECT c.lesson_date, c.start_time, c.discipline, m.first_name, m.last_name FROM lessons c JOIN instructors m ON m.id = c.instructor_id WHERE c.status = 'Held' AND strftime('%w', c.lesson_date) IN ('0', '6') ORDER BY c.lesson_date, c.start_time;
SELECT r.name, r.type, COUNT(p.id) AS ride_count FROM lifts r LEFT JOIN lift_rides p ON p.lift_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.type ORDER BY ride_count DESC, r.name;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS pass_count, SUM(price) AS revenue, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM passes GROUP BY month HAVING SUM(price) > 1500 ORDER BY month;

SELECT c.lesson_date, c.start_time, c.discipline, c.level, COUNT(i.id) AS enrolled_count FROM lessons c JOIN enrollments i ON i.lesson_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 'Held' GROUP BY c.id, c.lesson_date, c.start_time, c.discipline, c.level, c.max_spots HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= c.max_spots ORDER BY c.lesson_date, c.start_time;

SELECT color, COUNT(*) AS slope_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Open' THEN length_m ELSE 0 END) / 1000.0, 1) AS open_km FROM slopes GROUP BY color ORDER BY open_count DESC, color;
SELECT f.id, f.type, f.start_date, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM passes f LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = f.customer_id LEFT JOIN lift_rides p ON p.pass_id = f.id WHERE p.id IS NULL ORDER BY f.id;

SELECT CASE WHEN ride_time < '09:00' THEN 'Opening' WHEN ride_time < '12:00' THEN 'Morning' WHEN ride_time < '14:00' THEN 'Midday' ELSE 'Afternoon' END AS time_slot, COUNT(*) AS ride_count FROM lift_rides GROUP BY time_slot ORDER BY ride_count DESC;
SELECT day_date, snow_depth_cm FROM weather WHERE snow_depth_cm > (SELECT AVG(snow_depth_cm) FROM weather) ORDER BY day_date;
SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS pass_count, ROUND(AVG(julianday(start_date) - julianday(purchase_date)), 1) AS avg_lead_days FROM passes GROUP BY type ORDER BY avg_lead_days DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT cl.first_name, cl.last_name, cl.birth_date FROM instructors m JOIN lessons c ON c.instructor_id = m.id JOIN enrollments i ON i.lesson_id = c.id JOIN customers cl ON cl.id = i.customer_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Océane' AND m.last_name = 'Perrin' AND c.status = 'Held' ORDER BY cl.last_name, cl.first_name;
SELECT p.sector, p.name, p.color, COALESCE(r.name, 'Link') AS lift FROM slopes p LEFT JOIN lifts r ON r.id = p.lift_id WHERE p.status = 'Open' ORDER BY p.sector, p.name;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(i.id) AS enrollment_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(i.id) DESC) AS rank FROM instructors m LEFT JOIN lessons c ON c.instructor_id = m.id AND c.status = 'Held' LEFT JOIN enrollments i ON i.lesson_id = c.id GROUP BY m.id, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY rank, m.last_name;

WITH variations AS (SELECT day_date, snow_depth_cm, LAG(snow_depth_cm) OVER (ORDER BY day_date) AS previous_day_depth FROM weather) SELECT day_date, snow_depth_cm, previous_day_depth, snow_depth_cm - previous_day_depth AS change FROM variations WHERE snow_depth_cm < previous_day_depth ORDER BY day_date;

SELECT m.day_date, COUNT(p.id) AS ride_count, SUM(COUNT(p.id)) OVER (ORDER BY m.day_date) AS running_total FROM weather m LEFT JOIN lift_rides p ON p.ride_date = m.day_date GROUP BY m.day_date ORDER BY m.day_date;

SELECT f.id, f.type, f.price, COUNT(m.id) AS closed_days, ROUND(f.price * COUNT(m.id) / (julianday(f.end_date) - julianday(f.start_date) + 1), 2) AS refund FROM passes f JOIN weather m ON m.day_date BETWEEN f.start_date AND f.end_date AND m.resort_status = 'Fully closed' WHERE f.type IN ('Day', 'Week') GROUP BY f.id, f.type, f.price, f.start_date, f.end_date ORDER BY f.id;

WITH per_lesson AS (SELECT c.id, c.discipline, c.level, c.max_spots, COUNT(i.id) AS enrolled_count FROM lessons c LEFT JOIN enrollments i ON i.lesson_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 'Held' GROUP BY c.id, c.discipline, c.level, c.max_spots) SELECT discipline, level, SUM(enrolled_count) AS enrolled, SUM(max_spots) AS spots, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(enrolled_count) / SUM(max_spots), 1) AS fill_rate FROM per_lesson GROUP BY discipline, level ORDER BY fill_rate DESC;

WITH gradients AS (SELECT color, name, vertical_drop_m * 100.0 / length_m AS gradient FROM slopes), averages AS (SELECT color, AVG(gradient) AS average FROM gradients GROUP BY color) SELECT p.color, p.name, ROUND(p.gradient, 1) AS slope_pct, ROUND(m.average, 1) AS color_average FROM gradients p JOIN averages m ON m.color = p.color WHERE p.gradient > m.average ORDER BY p.color, p.gradient DESC, p.name;

SELECT cl.first_name, cl.last_name FROM customers cl WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lifts r WHERE r.sector = 'Crêtes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lift_rides p JOIN passes f ON f.id = p.pass_id WHERE f.customer_id = cl.id AND p.lift_id = r.id)) ORDER BY cl.last_name, cl.first_name;

WITH ranked AS (SELECT p.ride_date, p.ride_time, p.pass_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ride_date ORDER BY p.ride_time, p.id) AS rank FROM lift_rides p) SELECT c.ride_date, c.ride_time, c.pass_id, cl.first_name, cl.last_name FROM ranked c JOIN passes f ON f.id = c.pass_id LEFT JOIN customers cl ON cl.id = f.customer_id WHERE c.rank = 1 ORDER BY c.ride_date;

SELECT DISTINCT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM customers l JOIN enrollments il ON il.customer_id = l.id JOIN lessons c ON c.id = il.lesson_id JOIN enrollments ia ON ia.lesson_id = il.lesson_id JOIN customers a ON a.id = ia.customer_id WHERE l.first_name = 'Lina' AND l.last_name = 'Vidal' AND c.status = 'Held' AND a.id <> l.id ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name;

WITH ages AS (SELECT f.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, f.rate, CAST(strftime('%Y', f.start_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d', f.start_date) < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date)) AS age FROM passes f JOIN customers c ON c.id = f.customer_id) SELECT id, first_name, last_name, age, rate, CASE WHEN age < 12 THEN 'Child' WHEN age < 65 THEN 'Adult' ELSE 'Senior' END AS expected_rate FROM ages WHERE rate <> CASE WHEN age < 12 THEN 'Child' WHEN age < 65 THEN 'Adult' ELSE 'Senior' END ORDER BY id;
SELECT name, type FROM locations WHERE power_outlet = 0 ORDER BY name;
SELECT p.name, c.name AS vehicle_type, p.price FROM dishes p JOIN trucks c ON c.id = p.truck_id WHERE p.vegetarian = 1 AND p.category = 'Main' ORDER BY p.price, p.name;
SELECT DISTINCT stop_date FROM stops WHERE weather = 'Rain' ORDER BY stop_date;
SELECT v.id, s.stop_date, v.order_time FROM sales v JOIN stops s ON s.id = v.stop_id WHERE v.handover_time IS NULL ORDER BY v.id;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS sale_count, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales WHERE payment_method = 'Meal voucher';
SELECT name, LENGTH(name) AS char_count FROM dishes WHERE LENGTH(name) > 20 ORDER BY char_count DESC;
SELECT first_name, last_name, stamps FROM customers WHERE stamps >= 8 ORDER BY stamps DESC, last_name, first_name;
SELECT v.id, s.stop_date, v.amount FROM sales v JOIN stops s ON s.id = v.stop_id ORDER BY v.amount DESC, v.id LIMIT 5;
SELECT first_name, last_name, card_date FROM customers WHERE strftime('%Y', card_date) = '2024' ORDER BY card_date;
SELECT p.name, s.stop_date, r.stockout_time FROM stockouts r JOIN dishes p ON p.id = r.dish_id JOIN stops s ON s.id = r.stop_id WHERE r.stockout_time < '12:00' ORDER BY r.stockout_time;
SELECT e.name, COUNT(s.id) AS stop_count FROM locations e LEFT JOIN stops s ON s.location_id = e.id AND s.status = 'Done' GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY stop_count DESC, e.name;

SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG((strftime('%s', v.handover_time) - strftime('%s', v.order_time)) / 60.0), 1) AS avg_wait FROM sales v JOIN stops s ON s.id = v.stop_id JOIN trucks c ON c.id = s.truck_id WHERE v.handover_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY avg_wait DESC;

SELECT s.weather, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS stop_count, COUNT(v.id) AS sale_count, SUM(v.amount) AS revenue FROM stops s JOIN sales v ON v.stop_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 'Done' GROUP BY s.weather ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN order_time < '11:00' THEN 'Morning' WHEN order_time < '15:00' THEN 'Midday' WHEN order_time < '18:00' THEN 'Afternoon' ELSE 'Evening' END AS time_of_day, COUNT(*) AS sale_count, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY time_of_day;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(v.id) AS sale_count FROM customers c JOIN sales v ON v.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(v.id) >= 5 ORDER BY sale_count DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;
SELECT p.name, c.name AS vehicle_type FROM dishes p JOIN trucks c ON c.id = p.truck_id LEFT JOIN sale_items l ON l.dish_id = p.id WHERE l.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.name, p.name;

SELECT c.name AS vehicle_type, p.name AS dish, SUM(l.quantity) AS portions FROM sale_items l JOIN dishes p ON p.id = l.dish_id JOIN trucks c ON c.id = p.truck_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, p.id, p.name ORDER BY c.name, portions DESC, p.name;
SELECT name, price FROM dishes WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM dishes) ORDER BY price DESC, name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(v.amount), 0) AS total FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales v ON v.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total DESC, c.last_name, c.first_name;

SELECT CASE strftime('%w', s.stop_date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS day, SUM(v.amount) AS revenue FROM stops s JOIN sales v ON v.stop_id = s.id GROUP BY day ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT e.name, COALESCE(SUM(v.amount), 0) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(v.amount), 0) DESC) AS rank FROM locations e LEFT JOIN stops s ON s.location_id = e.id LEFT JOIN sales v ON v.stop_id = s.id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY rank, e.name;

WITH mornings AS (SELECT s.stop_date, SUM(l.quantity) AS portions FROM stops s JOIN trucks c ON c.id = s.truck_id JOIN locations e ON e.id = s.location_id JOIN sales v ON v.stop_id = s.id JOIN sale_items l ON l.sale_id = v.id WHERE c.name = 'Le Carbu' AND e.name = 'Station Forecourt' AND s.status = 'Done' GROUP BY s.id, s.stop_date) SELECT stop_date, portions, LAG(portions) OVER (ORDER BY stop_date) AS previous_portions, portions - LAG(portions) OVER (ORDER BY stop_date) AS change FROM mornings ORDER BY stop_date;

WITH days AS (SELECT c.id AS truck_id, c.name, s.stop_date, SUM(v.amount) AS revenue FROM trucks c JOIN stops s ON s.truck_id = c.id JOIN sales v ON v.stop_id = s.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, s.stop_date) SELECT name, stop_date, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY truck_id ORDER BY stop_date) AS running_total FROM days ORDER BY name, stop_date;

WITH waits AS (SELECT v.id, s.truck_id, (strftime('%s', v.handover_time) - strftime('%s', v.order_time)) / 60 AS wait FROM sales v JOIN stops s ON s.id = v.stop_id WHERE v.handover_time IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT truck_id, AVG(wait) AS average FROM waits GROUP BY truck_id) SELECT c.name, a.id, a.wait, ROUND(m.average, 1) AS truck_average FROM waits a JOIN averages m ON m.truck_id = a.truck_id JOIN trucks c ON c.id = a.truck_id WHERE a.wait > m.average + 5 ORDER BY c.name, a.wait DESC, a.id;

SELECT a.stop_date, e.name AS location, ca.name AS vehicle_1, cb.name AS vehicle_2 FROM stops a JOIN stops b ON b.location_id = a.location_id AND b.stop_date = a.stop_date AND a.start_time < b.end_time AND b.start_time < a.end_time JOIN trucks ca ON ca.id = a.truck_id JOIN trucks cb ON cb.id = b.truck_id JOIN locations e ON e.id = a.location_id WHERE a.status = 'Done' AND b.status = 'Done' AND ca.name < cb.name ORDER BY a.stop_date, e.name, ca.name, cb.name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trucks k WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales v JOIN stops s ON s.id = v.stop_id WHERE v.customer_id = c.id AND s.truck_id = k.id)) ORDER BY c.last_name, c.first_name;
