WITH shares AS (SELECT c.name AS vehicle_type, e.type, SUM(CASE WHEN v.payment_method = 'Cash' THEN v.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(v.amount) AS share FROM sales v JOIN stops s ON s.id = v.stop_id JOIN trucks c ON c.id = s.truck_id JOIN locations e ON e.id = s.location_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, e.type), fleet AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN payment_method = 'Cash' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS share FROM sales) SELECT p.vehicle_type, p.type, ROUND(p.share, 1) AS cash_share, ROUND(f.share, 1) AS fleet_share FROM shares p CROSS JOIN fleet f WHERE p.share > f.share ORDER BY p.share DESC;

WITH dish_portions AS (SELECT p.truck_id, p.name, SUM(l.quantity) AS portions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.truck_id ORDER BY SUM(l.quantity) DESC, p.name) AS rn FROM dishes p JOIN sale_items l ON l.dish_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.truck_id, p.name) SELECT c.name, pp.name, pp.portions FROM dish_portions pp JOIN trucks c ON c.id = pp.truck_id WHERE pp.rn = 1 ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT s.stop_date, p.name, r.stockout_time, COUNT(v.id) AS sales_after FROM stockouts r JOIN stops s ON s.id = r.stop_id JOIN dishes p ON p.id = r.dish_id LEFT JOIN sales v ON v.stop_id = r.stop_id AND v.order_time > r.stockout_time GROUP BY r.id, s.stop_date, p.name, r.stockout_time ORDER BY sales_after DESC, s.stop_date, r.stockout_time;

WITH revenue AS (SELECT s.truck_id, SUM(v.amount) AS revenue FROM stops s JOIN sales v ON v.stop_id = s.id GROUP BY s.truck_id), fees AS (SELECT s.truck_id, SUM(e.daily_fee) AS fees FROM stops s JOIN locations e ON e.id = s.location_id WHERE s.status = 'Done' GROUP BY s.truck_id) SELECT c.name, revenue.revenue, r.fees, revenue.revenue - r.fees AS remaining FROM trucks c JOIN revenue ON revenue.truck_id = c.id JOIN fees r ON r.truck_id = c.id ORDER BY remaining DESC;
SELECT name, volume_liters, min_temp_c, max_temp_c FROM tanks WHERE water_type = 'Freshwater' ORDER BY volume_liters DESC, name;
SELECT id, type, install_date, status FROM equipment WHERE tank_id IS NULL ORDER BY install_date, id;
SELECT name, ROUND(volume_liters / 1000.0, 1) AS volume_m3 FROM tanks WHERE volume_liters < 10000 ORDER BY volume_liters, name;
SELECT DISTINCT species FROM residents WHERE origin = 'Wild-caught' ORDER BY species;
SELECT SUM(headcount) AS shark_count FROM residents WHERE category = 'Shark';

SELECT r.school, a.name, r.activity_date, r.start_time, r.student_count FROM bookings r JOIN activities a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', r.activity_date) = '2025-05' AND r.status <> 'Cancelled' ORDER BY r.activity_date, r.start_time, r.student_count DESC;
SELECT name, LENGTH(name) AS char_count FROM tanks WHERE LENGTH(name) > 20 ORDER BY char_count DESC, name;
SELECT p.species, p.headcount, b.name AS tank FROM residents p JOIN tanks b ON b.id = p.tank_id ORDER BY p.headcount DESC, p.species LIMIT 3;

SELECT b.name, r.reading_date, r.reading_time, r.nitrates_mg_l FROM readings r JOIN tanks b ON b.id = r.tank_id WHERE r.nitrates_mg_l > 25 ORDER BY r.nitrates_mg_l DESC, r.reading_date, r.reading_time;
SELECT i.start_date, e.type, i.cost, i.description FROM interventions i JOIN equipment e ON e.id = i.equipment_id WHERE i.description LIKE '%leak%' ORDER BY i.start_date;

SELECT b.name, COUNT(p.id) AS group_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.headcount), 0) AS animal_count FROM tanks b LEFT JOIN residents p ON p.tank_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY animal_count DESC, b.name;

SELECT b.name, r.reading_date, r.reading_time, r.temperature_c, CASE WHEN r.temperature_c < b.min_temp_c THEN 'Too cold' ELSE 'Too hot' END AS direction FROM readings r JOIN tanks b ON b.id = r.tank_id WHERE r.temperature_c < b.min_temp_c OR r.temperature_c > b.max_temp_c ORDER BY r.reading_date, r.reading_time, b.name;
SELECT species, COUNT(DISTINCT tank_id) AS tank_count, SUM(headcount) AS animal_count FROM residents GROUP BY species HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tank_id) >= 2 ORDER BY tank_count DESC, species;

SELECT b.name, MIN(r.temperature_c) AS lowest_temp, MAX(r.temperature_c) AS highest_temp, ROUND(MAX(r.temperature_c) - MIN(r.temperature_c), 1) AS temp_range FROM tanks b JOIN readings r ON r.tank_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY temp_range DESC, b.name;

SELECT e.type, COUNT(i.id) AS breakdown_count, ROUND(AVG(julianday(i.end_date) - julianday(i.start_date)), 1) AS avg_duration_days FROM interventions i JOIN equipment e ON e.id = i.equipment_id WHERE i.intervention_type = 'Breakdown' AND i.end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.type ORDER BY avg_duration_days DESC, breakdown_count DESC;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', r.activity_date) AS month, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count, SUM(r.student_count) AS student_count, SUM(r.student_count * a.price_per_student) AS revenue FROM bookings r JOIN activities a ON a.id = r.activity_id WHERE r.status = 'Confirmed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

SELECT b.name, COUNT(r.id) AS reading_count, COUNT(r.id) - COUNT(r.nitrates_mg_l) AS missing_nitrates_count FROM tanks b JOIN readings r ON r.tank_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.name HAVING COUNT(r.id) - COUNT(r.nitrates_mg_l) > 0 ORDER BY missing_nitrates_count DESC, b.name;
SELECT p.species, b.name, p.headcount FROM residents p JOIN tanks b ON b.id = p.tank_id WHERE p.tank_id IN (SELECT tank_id FROM equipment WHERE status = 'Broken down') ORDER BY b.name, p.species;

SELECT COALESCE(contractor, 'In-house team') AS contractor, COUNT(*) AS intervention_count, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM interventions GROUP BY COALESCE(contractor, 'In-house team') ORDER BY total_cost DESC;
SELECT a.name, COUNT(r.id) AS confirmed_count FROM activities a LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.activity_id = a.id AND r.status = 'Confirmed' GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY confirmed_count DESC, a.name;

WITH tracking AS (SELECT b.name, b.zone, r.reading_date, r.reading_time, r.temperature_c, LAG(r.temperature_c) OVER (PARTITION BY r.tank_id ORDER BY r.reading_date, r.reading_time) AS previous_temperature FROM readings r JOIN tanks b ON b.id = r.tank_id) SELECT name, reading_date, reading_time, temperature_c, previous_temperature, ROUND(temperature_c - previous_temperature, 1) AS change FROM tracking WHERE zone = 'Atlantic Gallery' AND reading_date BETWEEN '2025-06-28' AND '2025-07-02' ORDER BY name, reading_date, reading_time;

WITH history AS (SELECT b.name, r.reading_date, LAG(r.reading_date) OVER (PARTITION BY r.tank_id ORDER BY r.reading_date, r.reading_time) AS previous_date FROM readings r JOIN tanks b ON b.id = r.tank_id) SELECT name, previous_date, reading_date, julianday(reading_date) - julianday(previous_date) AS day_count FROM history WHERE julianday(reading_date) - julianday(previous_date) > 3 ORDER BY day_count DESC, name;

WITH ranked AS (SELECT b.name, r.reading_date, r.reading_time, r.temperature_c, r.ph, r.nitrates_mg_l, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.tank_id ORDER BY r.reading_date DESC, r.reading_time DESC) AS rank FROM readings r JOIN tanks b ON b.id = r.tank_id) SELECT name, reading_date, reading_time, temperature_c, ph, nitrates_mg_l FROM ranked WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY name;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(r.id) AS reading_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC) AS rank FROM aquarists a LEFT JOIN readings r ON r.aquarist_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY rank, a.last_name;

WITH days AS (SELECT activity_date, SUM(student_count) AS student_count FROM bookings WHERE status = 'Confirmed' AND activity_date BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2025-06-30' GROUP BY activity_date) SELECT activity_date, student_count, SUM(student_count) OVER (ORDER BY activity_date) AS running_total FROM days ORDER BY activity_date;

SELECT e.id, e.type, b.name AS tank, e.install_date FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN tanks b ON b.id = e.tank_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interventions i WHERE i.equipment_id = e.id AND i.intervention_type = 'Breakdown') ORDER BY e.install_date, e.id;

SELECT a.name, r1.activity_date, r1.start_time, r1.school, r2.school FROM bookings r1 JOIN bookings r2 ON r2.activity_id = r1.activity_id AND r2.activity_date = r1.activity_date AND r2.start_time = r1.start_time AND r2.id > r1.id JOIN activities a ON a.id = r1.activity_id WHERE r1.status <> 'Cancelled' AND r2.status <> 'Cancelled' ORDER BY r1.activity_date, r1.start_time;

SELECT b.name, COUNT(r.id) AS reading_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.temperature_c < b.min_temp_c OR r.temperature_c > b.max_temp_c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_of_range_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.temperature_c < b.min_temp_c OR r.temperature_c > b.max_temp_c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(r.id), 1) AS share_pct FROM tanks b JOIN readings r ON r.tank_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY share_pct DESC, b.name;

WITH costs AS (SELECT e.type, i.id, i.start_date, i.cost FROM interventions i JOIN equipment e ON e.id = i.equipment_id), averages AS (SELECT type, AVG(cost) AS average FROM costs GROUP BY type) SELECT c.type, c.id, c.start_date, c.cost, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS type_average FROM costs c JOIN averages m ON m.type = c.type WHERE c.cost > m.average ORDER BY c.cost DESC;

SELECT b.name, COALESCE(SUM(i.cost), 0) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(i.cost), 0) DESC) AS rank FROM tanks b LEFT JOIN equipment e ON e.tank_id = b.id LEFT JOIN interventions i ON i.equipment_id = e.id GROUP BY b.id, b.name ORDER BY rank, b.name;
SELECT p.id, v.number, p.breakdown_type, p.report_date FROM breakdowns p JOIN bikes v ON v.id = p.bike_id WHERE p.repair_date IS NULL ORDER BY p.report_date, p.id;
SELECT t.id, a.first_name, a.last_name, t.ride_date, t.duration_min FROM rides t JOIN members a ON a.id = t.member_id WHERE t.duration_min > 45 ORDER BY t.duration_min DESC, t.id;

SELECT t.id, s.name, t.ride_date, t.start_time, t.duration_min FROM rides t JOIN stations s ON s.id = t.start_station_id WHERE t.end_station_id = t.start_station_id ORDER BY t.ride_date, t.start_time, t.id;
SELECT name, district, dock_count FROM stations WHERE dock_count >= 10 ORDER BY dock_count DESC, name;
SELECT DISTINCT breakdown_type FROM breakdowns WHERE report_date BETWEEN '2025-05-01' AND '2025-05-31' ORDER BY breakdown_type;
SELECT name, LENGTH(name) AS length FROM stations WHERE LENGTH(name) > 16 ORDER BY length DESC, name;
SELECT number, service_date, status FROM bikes WHERE type = 'Electric' AND service_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY service_date, number LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ride_count FROM rides WHERE ride_date BETWEEN '2025-06-02' AND '2025-06-06' AND start_time >= '07:00' AND start_time < '09:00';
SELECT SUM(bike_count) AS total_bikes FROM rebalancing WHERE operation_time < '12:00';
SELECT UPPER(last_name) AS last_name_upper, first_name, signup_date FROM members WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2024-03-01' AND '2024-03-31' ORDER BY signup_date, last_name;
SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) AS member_count FROM stations s LEFT JOIN rides t ON t.start_station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY member_count DESC, s.name;

SELECT s.district, v.type, COUNT(t.id) AS ride_count, ROUND(AVG(t.duration_min), 1) AS avg_duration FROM rides t JOIN stations s ON s.id = t.start_station_id JOIN bikes v ON v.id = t.bike_id GROUP BY s.district, v.type ORDER BY s.district, v.type;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, COUNT(t.id) AS ride_count, SUM(t.duration_min) AS total_duration FROM members a JOIN rides t ON t.member_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name HAVING COUNT(t.id) >= 6 ORDER BY ride_count DESC, a.last_name, a.first_name;

SELECT breakdown_type, COUNT(*) AS repaired_count, ROUND(AVG(julianday(repair_date) - julianday(report_date)), 1) AS avg_delay_days, ROUND(AVG(repair_cost), 2) AS avg_cost FROM breakdowns WHERE repair_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY breakdown_type ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC, breakdown_type;
SELECT CASE WHEN duration_min < 15 THEN 'Under 15 min' WHEN duration_min <= 45 THEN '15 to 45 min' ELSE 'Over 45 min' END AS bracket, COUNT(*) AS ride_count FROM rides GROUP BY bracket;

SELECT t.id, a.first_name, a.last_name, f.name AS plan, t.duration_min, t.duration_min - f.included_minutes AS overage FROM rides t JOIN members a ON a.id = t.member_id JOIN plans f ON f.id = a.plan_id WHERE t.duration_min > f.included_minutes ORDER BY overage DESC, t.id;

SELECT strftime('%H', start_time) AS hour, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', ride_date) IN ('0', '6') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS weekdays, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', ride_date) IN ('0', '6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend FROM rides GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, t.ride_date, t.duration_min FROM rides t JOIN members a ON a.id = t.member_id WHERE t.duration_min = (SELECT MAX(duration_min) FROM rides) ORDER BY t.ride_date, t.id;

SELECT v.number, COALESCE(SUM(t.duration_min), 0) AS minutes_ridden FROM bikes v LEFT JOIN rides t ON t.bike_id = v.id WHERE v.type = 'Classic' AND v.status = 'In service' GROUP BY v.id, v.number ORDER BY minutes_ridden DESC, v.number;

SELECT s.name, s.district, COUNT(*) AS empty_count FROM station_counts r JOIN stations s ON s.id = r.station_id WHERE r.bike_count = 0 AND r.count_time IN ('08:00', '18:00') GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.district ORDER BY empty_count DESC, s.name;

WITH departures AS (SELECT start_station_id AS station_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rides GROUP BY start_station_id), arrivals AS (SELECT end_station_id AS station_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rides GROUP BY end_station_id) SELECT s.name, COALESCE(d.count, 0) AS departure_count, COALESCE(a.count, 0) AS arrival_count, COALESCE(a.count, 0) - COALESCE(d.count, 0) AS balance FROM stations s LEFT JOIN departures d ON d.station_id = s.id LEFT JOIN arrivals a ON a.station_id = s.id ORDER BY balance, s.name;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, f.name AS plan, COUNT(t.id) AS ride_count FROM members a JOIN plans f ON f.id = a.plan_id JOIN rides t ON t.member_id = a.id WHERE f.name IN ('Annual', 'Monthly') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rides t2 JOIN bikes v ON v.id = t2.bike_id WHERE t2.member_id = a.id AND v.type = 'Electric') GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name, f.name ORDER BY ride_count DESC, a.last_name, a.first_name;

SELECT s.name, COALESCE(SUM(r.bike_count), 0) AS bikes_dropped, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(r.bike_count), 0) DESC) AS rank FROM stations s LEFT JOIN rebalancing r ON r.destination_station_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY rank, s.name;

SELECT v.type, v.number, COUNT(p.id) AS breakdown_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY v.type ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC) AS rank FROM bikes v JOIN breakdowns p ON p.bike_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.type, v.number ORDER BY v.type, rank, v.number;

WITH sequence AS (SELECT t.bike_id, t.ride_date, t.start_time, t.start_station_id, LAG(t.end_station_id) OVER (PARTITION BY t.bike_id ORDER BY t.ride_date, t.start_time, t.id) AS previous_arrival FROM rides t) SELECT v.number, s.ride_date, s.start_time, sp.name AS previous_station, sd.name AS start_station FROM sequence s JOIN bikes v ON v.id = s.bike_id JOIN stations sp ON sp.id = s.previous_arrival JOIN stations sd ON sd.id = s.start_station_id WHERE s.start_station_id <> s.previous_arrival ORDER BY v.number, s.ride_date, s.start_time;
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS signup_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date)) AS running_total FROM members GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

SELECT number, ride_date, end_time, end_station FROM (SELECT v.number, t.ride_date, t.end_time, s.name AS end_station, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.id ORDER BY t.ride_date DESC, t.start_time DESC) AS rn FROM bikes v JOIN rides t ON t.bike_id = v.id JOIN stations s ON s.id = t.end_station_id WHERE v.type = 'Electric') AS latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY number;

SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, sa.name AS outbound_station, sb.name AS return_station, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ride_date) AS day_count FROM rides t1 JOIN rides t2 ON t2.member_id = t1.member_id AND t2.ride_date = t1.ride_date AND t2.start_station_id = t1.end_station_id AND t2.end_station_id = t1.start_station_id AND t2.start_time > t1.start_time JOIN members a ON a.id = t1.member_id JOIN stations sa ON sa.id = t1.start_station_id JOIN stations sb ON sb.id = t1.end_station_id WHERE t1.start_station_id <> t1.end_station_id GROUP BY a.id, a.first_name, a.last_name, sa.name, sb.name ORDER BY a.last_name, a.first_name, outbound_station;

SELECT f.name, COUNT(t.id) AS ride_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.type = 'Electric' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS electric_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN v.type = 'Electric' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(t.id), 1) AS electric_share FROM plans f JOIN members a ON a.plan_id = f.id JOIN rides t ON t.member_id = a.id JOIN bikes v ON v.id = t.bike_id GROUP BY f.id, f.name ORDER BY electric_share DESC, f.name;

WITH totals AS (SELECT a.id, f.name AS plan, a.first_name, a.last_name, SUM(t.duration_min) AS total FROM members a JOIN plans f ON f.id = a.plan_id JOIN rides t ON t.member_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, f.name, a.first_name, a.last_name), averages AS (SELECT plan, AVG(total) AS average FROM totals GROUP BY plan) SELECT t.plan, t.first_name, t.last_name, t.total, ROUND(m.average) AS plan_average FROM totals t JOIN averages m ON m.plan = t.plan WHERE t.total > m.average ORDER BY t.plan, t.total DESC, t.last_name;
SELECT r.name, ru.name AS apiary, r.breed, r.install_date FROM hives r JOIN apiaries ru ON ru.id = r.apiary_id WHERE r.status = 'Dead' ORDER BY r.install_date, r.name, r.id;
SELECT v.inspection_date, r.name, v.note FROM inspections v JOIN hives r ON r.id = v.hive_id WHERE v.varroa IS NULL ORDER BY v.inspection_date, r.name, r.id;
SELECT name, town, altitude_m FROM apiaries WHERE altitude_m > 600 ORDER BY altitude_m DESC, name, id;
SELECT DISTINCT breed FROM hives ORDER BY breed;
SELECT r.name, rc.harvest_date, rc.honey_type, rc.weight_kg FROM harvests rc JOIN hives r ON r.id = rc.hive_id ORDER BY rc.weight_kg DESC, rc.harvest_date, rc.id LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvest_count, SUM(weight_kg) AS total_weight_kg FROM harvests WHERE honey_type = 'Lavender' AND harvest_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31';
SELECT r.name, v.inspection_date, v.note FROM inspections v JOIN hives r ON r.id = v.hive_id WHERE v.note LIKE '%swarm%' ORDER BY v.inspection_date, r.name, r.id;
SELECT batch_number, size_g, jar_price, ROUND(jar_price * 1000 / size_g, 2) AS price_per_kg FROM batches WHERE harvest_year = 2025 ORDER BY price_per_kg DESC, batch_number;
SELECT name, city, day FROM outlets WHERE day IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') ORDER BY name, id;
SELECT harvest_date, hive_id, honey_type, weight_kg FROM harvests WHERE strftime('%m', harvest_date) = '07' ORDER BY harvest_date, hive_id;
SELECT ru.name, ru.altitude_m, COUNT(r.id) AS hive_count FROM apiaries ru LEFT JOIN hives r ON r.apiary_id = ru.id GROUP BY ru.id, ru.name, ru.altitude_m ORDER BY hive_count DESC, ru.name, ru.id;

SELECT ru.name, strftime('%Y', rc.harvest_date) AS year, COUNT(rc.id) AS harvest_count, SUM(rc.weight_kg) AS total_weight_kg FROM harvests rc JOIN hives r ON r.id = rc.hive_id JOIN apiaries ru ON ru.id = r.apiary_id GROUP BY ru.id, ru.name, year ORDER BY ru.name, year;

SELECT r.name, ru.name AS apiary, r.status, r.install_date FROM hives r JOIN apiaries ru ON ru.id = r.apiary_id LEFT JOIN harvests rc ON rc.hive_id = r.id WHERE rc.id IS NULL ORDER BY r.install_date, r.name, r.id;

SELECT p.name, SUM(v.jar_count) AS jars_sold, ROUND(SUM(v.jar_count * l.jar_price), 2) AS revenue FROM outlets p JOIN sales v ON v.outlet_id = p.id JOIN batches l ON l.id = v.batch_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.name;

SELECT l.batch_number, l.jars_filled, COALESCE(SUM(v.jar_count), 0) AS jars_sold, l.jars_filled - COALESCE(SUM(v.jar_count), 0) AS jars_left FROM batches l LEFT JOIN sales v ON v.batch_id = l.id GROUP BY l.id, l.batch_number, l.jars_filled HAVING l.jars_filled - COALESCE(SUM(v.jar_count), 0) > 0 ORDER BY jars_left DESC, l.batch_number;

SELECT CASE WHEN varroa IS NULL THEN 'Not counted' WHEN varroa <= 3 THEN 'Low' WHEN varroa <= 9 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS inspection_count FROM inspections WHERE inspection_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY level;

SELECT r.name, r.status, COUNT(v.id) AS inspection_count, ROUND(AVG(v.strength_frames)) AS avg_strength FROM hives r JOIN inspections v ON v.hive_id = r.id WHERE r.status <> 'Dead' AND v.inspection_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.status HAVING AVG(v.strength_frames) < 5 ORDER BY AVG(v.strength_frames), r.name, r.id;

SELECT r.name, v.strength_frames, v.queen_seen, v.note FROM inspections v JOIN hives r ON r.id = v.hive_id WHERE v.inspection_date = (SELECT MAX(inspection_date) FROM inspections) ORDER BY r.name, r.id;

SELECT product, COUNT(*) AS treatment_count, ROUND(AVG(julianday(end_date) - julianday(start_date)), 1) AS avg_duration_days FROM treatments WHERE end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product ORDER BY avg_duration_days DESC, product;

SELECT ru.name, COUNT(DISTINCT rc.honey_type) AS type_count, COUNT(rc.id) AS harvest_count FROM apiaries ru JOIN hives r ON r.apiary_id = ru.id JOIN harvests rc ON rc.hive_id = r.id GROUP BY ru.id, ru.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rc.honey_type) >= 2 ORDER BY ru.name, ru.id;

WITH t AS (SELECT honey_type, strftime('%Y', harvest_date) AS year, SUM(weight_kg) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT hive_id) AS yield FROM harvests GROUP BY honey_type, year), e AS (SELECT honey_type, year, yield, LAG(yield) OVER (PARTITION BY honey_type ORDER BY year) AS previous_yield FROM t) SELECT honey_type, ROUND(previous_yield, 2) AS yield_2024, ROUND(yield, 2) AS yield_2025, ROUND(100.0 * (yield - previous_yield) / previous_yield, 1) AS change_pct FROM e WHERE year = '2025' ORDER BY change_pct DESC, honey_type;

SELECT ru.name AS apiary, r.name AS hive, SUM(rc.weight_kg) AS kilos_2025, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ru.id ORDER BY SUM(rc.weight_kg) DESC) AS rank FROM apiaries ru JOIN hives r ON r.apiary_id = ru.id JOIN harvests rc ON rc.hive_id = r.id WHERE rc.harvest_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY ru.id, ru.name, r.id, r.name ORDER BY ru.name, rank, r.name, r.id;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', v.sale_date) AS month, SUM(v.jar_count * l.jar_price) AS turnover FROM sales v JOIN batches l ON l.id = v.batch_id WHERE v.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(turnover, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(turnover) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS running_total FROM monthly ORDER BY month;

WITH totals AS (SELECT r.id, r.name, r.breed, SUM(rc.weight_kg) AS total FROM hives r JOIN harvests rc ON rc.hive_id = r.id WHERE r.status <> 'Dead' GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.breed), averages AS (SELECT breed, AVG(total) AS average FROM totals GROUP BY breed) SELECT t.breed, t.name, t.total, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS breed_average FROM totals t JOIN averages m ON m.breed = t.breed WHERE t.total > m.average ORDER BY t.breed, t.total DESC, t.name, t.id;

WITH ranked AS (SELECT r.id, r.name, v.inspection_date, v.strength_frames, v.queen_seen, v.varroa, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.id ORDER BY v.inspection_date DESC) AS rn FROM hives r JOIN inspections v ON v.hive_id = r.id) SELECT name, inspection_date, strength_frames, queen_seen, varroa FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY name, id;

WITH tracking AS (SELECT r.id, r.name, v.inspection_date, v.strength_frames, LAG(v.strength_frames) OVER (PARTITION BY r.id ORDER BY v.inspection_date) AS previous_strength FROM hives r JOIN inspections v ON v.hive_id = r.id) SELECT name, inspection_date, previous_strength, strength_frames, previous_strength - strength_frames AS loss FROM tracking WHERE previous_strength - strength_frames >= 4 ORDER BY inspection_date, name, id;

SELECT p.name, p.city FROM outlets p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batches t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales v JOIN batches l ON l.id = v.batch_id WHERE v.outlet_id = p.id AND l.honey_type = t.honey_type)) ORDER BY p.name, p.id;

WITH turnover AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', v.sale_date) AS sale_year, l.honey_type, SUM(v.jar_count * l.jar_price) AS amount FROM sales v JOIN batches l ON l.id = v.batch_id GROUP BY strftime('%Y', v.sale_date), l.honey_type) SELECT sale_year, honey_type, ROUND(amount, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(100.0 * amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY sale_year), 1) AS share_pct FROM turnover ORDER BY sale_year, share_pct DESC, honey_type;

SELECT p.harvest_year, p.honey_type, p.size_g, g.size_g AS next_size, ROUND(p.jar_price * 1000.0 / p.size_g - g.jar_price * 1000.0 / g.size_g, 2) AS gap FROM batches p JOIN batches g ON g.honey_type = p.honey_type AND g.harvest_year = p.harvest_year AND g.size_g > p.size_g WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batches m WHERE m.honey_type = p.honey_type AND m.harvest_year = p.harvest_year AND m.size_g > p.size_g AND m.size_g < g.size_g) ORDER BY p.harvest_year, p.honey_type, p.size_g;

SELECT r.name, ru.name AS apiary, v.inspection_date, v.varroa FROM inspections v JOIN hives r ON r.id = v.hive_id JOIN apiaries ru ON ru.id = r.apiary_id WHERE v.varroa > 9 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM treatments t WHERE t.hive_id = v.hive_id AND t.start_date BETWEEN v.inspection_date AND date(v.inspection_date, '+30 days')) ORDER BY v.inspection_date, r.name, r.id;
SELECT name, time_limit_min, price_per_player FROM rooms WHERE min_players <= 6 AND max_players >= 6 AND opening_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY price_per_player, name, id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, languages FROM game_masters WHERE languages LIKE '%English%' ORDER BY last_name, first_name, id;
SELECT p.id, m.first_name, m.last_name FROM games p JOIN game_masters m ON m.id = p.game_master_id WHERE p.escaped = 0 AND p.hints_requested = 0 ORDER BY p.id;
SELECT id, time_seconds, hints_requested FROM games WHERE time_seconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time_seconds, id LIMIT 5;
SELECT name, LENGTH(name) AS length FROM teams WHERE LENGTH(name) > 20 ORDER BY length DESC, name;

SELECT r.game_date, s.name, r.time_slot, r.player_count FROM bookings r JOIN rooms s ON s.id = r.room_id WHERE strftime('%w', r.game_date) = '0' AND r.time_slot < '12:00' ORDER BY r.game_date, r.time_slot, r.id;
SELECT DISTINCT e.name, e.email FROM bookings r JOIN teams e ON e.id = r.team_id WHERE r.channel = 'Phone' ORDER BY e.name;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancellation_count, SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refunded FROM cancellations;
SELECT id, rating, comment, review_date FROM reviews WHERE rating <= 2 ORDER BY rating, review_date, id;
SELECT e.step, e.name, e.type FROM puzzles e JOIN rooms s ON s.id = e.room_id WHERE s.name = 'Orbital Station 9' ORDER BY e.step;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, COUNT(p.id) AS game_count FROM game_masters m LEFT JOIN games p ON p.game_master_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY game_count DESC, m.last_name, m.first_name, m.id;

SELECT s.name, COUNT(p.id) AS game_count, SUM(p.escaped) AS escaped_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(p.escaped) / COUNT(p.id), 1) AS success_rate FROM rooms s JOIN bookings r ON r.room_id = s.id JOIN games p ON p.booking_id = r.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY success_rate DESC, s.name, s.id;

SELECT CASE WHEN hints_requested = 0 THEN 'No hints' WHEN hints_requested <= 2 THEN '1 or 2 hints' ELSE '3 hints or more' END AS hint_group, COUNT(*) AS game_count, SUM(escaped) AS escaped_count FROM games GROUP BY hint_group ORDER BY game_count DESC;

SELECT e.name, r.game_date, julianday(r.game_date) - julianday(a.cancellation_date) AS days_before, a.refund_amount FROM cancellations a JOIN bookings r ON r.id = a.booking_id JOIN teams e ON e.id = r.team_id ORDER BY days_before, r.game_date, a.id;

SELECT s.name, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count, COALESCE(SUM(r.price), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(a.refund_amount), 0) AS net_revenue FROM rooms s LEFT JOIN bookings r ON r.room_id = s.id LEFT JOIN cancellations a ON a.booking_id = r.id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, s.name, s.id;

SELECT s.name, ROUND(AVG(av.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(av.id) AS review_count FROM reviews av JOIN games p ON p.id = av.game_id JOIN bookings r ON r.id = p.booking_id JOIN rooms s ON s.id = r.room_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING AVG(av.rating) > (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews) ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, s.name;

SELECT e.name, e.captain_first_name, e.captain_last_name, COUNT(p.id) AS game_count FROM teams e JOIN bookings r ON r.team_id = e.id JOIN games p ON p.booking_id = r.id GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.captain_first_name, e.captain_last_name HAVING COUNT(p.id) >= 3 ORDER BY game_count DESC, e.name;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', r.game_date) AS month, COUNT(r.id) AS booking_count, COUNT(a.id) AS cancellation_count FROM bookings r LEFT JOIN cancellations a ON a.booking_id = r.id GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

SELECT r.promo_code, COUNT(*) AS booking_count, ROUND(SUM(r.player_count * s.price_per_player - r.price), 2) AS total_discounts FROM bookings r JOIN rooms s ON s.id = r.room_id WHERE r.promo_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.promo_code ORDER BY total_discounts DESC;

SELECT e.name, e.captain_first_name, e.captain_last_name, s.name AS room, r.game_date FROM bookings r JOIN teams e ON e.id = r.team_id JOIN rooms s ON s.id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN cancellations a ON a.booking_id = r.id LEFT JOIN games p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE a.id IS NULL AND p.id IS NULL ORDER BY r.game_date, r.id;

WITH times AS (SELECT s.id AS room_id, s.name AS room, e.name AS team, p.time_seconds, r.game_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY p.time_seconds) AS rank FROM games p JOIN bookings r ON r.id = p.booking_id JOIN rooms s ON s.id = r.room_id JOIN teams e ON e.id = r.team_id WHERE p.time_seconds IS NOT NULL) SELECT room, team, time_seconds, game_date FROM times WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY room, team;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, ROUND(AVG(a.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(a.id) AS review_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(a.rating) DESC) AS rank FROM game_masters m JOIN games p ON p.game_master_id = m.id JOIN reviews a ON a.game_id = p.id GROUP BY m.id, m.first_name, m.last_name ORDER BY rank, m.last_name, m.first_name;

WITH sequence AS (SELECT e.id AS team_id, e.name, r.game_date, r.time_slot, LAG(r.game_date) OVER (PARTITION BY e.id ORDER BY r.game_date, r.time_slot) AS previous_date FROM games p JOIN bookings r ON r.id = p.booking_id JOIN teams e ON e.id = r.team_id) SELECT name, game_date, previous_date, julianday(game_date) - julianday(previous_date) AS day_count FROM sequence WHERE previous_date IS NOT NULL AND julianday(game_date) - julianday(previous_date) < 30 ORDER BY name, game_date, time_slot;

WITH by_month AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', r.game_date) AS month, SUM(r.price) - COALESCE(SUM(a.refund_amount), 0) AS revenue FROM bookings r LEFT JOIN cancellations a ON a.booking_id = r.id GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', r.game_date)) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS running_revenue FROM by_month ORDER BY month;

WITH game_order AS (SELECT r.team_id, r.room_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team_id ORDER BY r.game_date, r.time_slot) AS number FROM games p JOIN bookings r ON r.id = p.booking_id) SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM game_order o JOIN rooms s ON s.id = o.room_id WHERE o.number = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY team_count DESC, s.name;

SELECT e.name, e.captain_first_name, e.captain_last_name, e.email FROM teams e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rooms s WHERE s.opening_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings r JOIN games p ON p.booking_id = r.id WHERE r.team_id = e.id AND r.room_id = s.id)) ORDER BY e.name;

WITH escapes AS (SELECT s.id AS room_id, s.name AS room, e.name AS team, p.time_seconds, AVG(p.time_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY s.id) AS average FROM games p JOIN bookings r ON r.id = p.booking_id JOIN rooms s ON s.id = r.room_id JOIN teams e ON e.id = r.team_id WHERE p.escaped = 1) SELECT room, team, time_seconds, ROUND(average, 1) AS avg_time FROM escapes WHERE time_seconds < average ORDER BY room, time_seconds, team;

WITH by_puzzle AS (SELECT s.id AS room_id, s.name AS room, en.step, en.name AS puzzle, COUNT(i.id) AS hint_count, SUM(COUNT(i.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.id) AS room_total FROM hints i JOIN puzzles en ON en.id = i.puzzle_id JOIN rooms s ON s.id = en.room_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name, en.id, en.step, en.name) SELECT room, puzzle, hint_count, ROUND(100.0 * hint_count / room_total, 1) AS share FROM by_puzzle WHERE 100.0 * hint_count / room_total >= 25 ORDER BY room, share DESC, step;

SELECT e.name, r1.game_date, s1.name AS first_room, r1.time_slot AS first_slot, s2.name AS second_room, r2.time_slot AS second_slot FROM bookings r1 JOIN games p1 ON p1.booking_id = r1.id JOIN bookings r2 ON r2.team_id = r1.team_id AND r2.game_date = r1.game_date AND r2.time_slot > r1.time_slot JOIN games p2 ON p2.booking_id = r2.id JOIN teams e ON e.id = r1.team_id JOIN rooms s1 ON s1.id = r1.room_id JOIN rooms s2 ON s2.id = r2.room_id ORDER BY r1.game_date, e.name;

SELECT e.name, r.booking_date, r.game_date FROM bookings r JOIN teams e ON e.id = r.team_id WHERE r.promo_code = 'LOYALTY' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings r0 JOIN games p0 ON p0.booking_id = r0.id WHERE r0.team_id = r.team_id AND r0.game_date <= r.booking_date) ORDER BY r.booking_date, r.id;
SELECT name, genre, country FROM artists WHERE fee IS NULL ORDER BY name, id;
SELECT first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM festivalgoers WHERE birth_date > '2007-07-04' ORDER BY birth_date, id;
SELECT name, fee FROM artists ORDER BY fee DESC, name LIMIT 3;
SELECT b.first_name, b.last_name, b.role, c.start_time, c.end_time FROM shifts c JOIN volunteers b ON b.id = c.volunteer_id WHERE c.day = '2025-07-03' ORDER BY c.start_time, b.last_name, c.id;
SELECT c.day, a.name, c.end_time FROM concerts c JOIN artists a ON a.id = c.artist_id WHERE c.status = 'Played' AND c.end_time > '23:00' ORDER BY c.day, c.end_time, c.id;
SELECT DISTINCT city FROM festivalgoers ORDER BY city;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pass_count, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM tickets WHERE pass_type = '3-day pass';

SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, f.email, b.purchase_date FROM tickets b JOIN festivalgoers f ON f.id = b.festivalgoer_id WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', b.purchase_date) = '2024-12' ORDER BY b.purchase_date, b.id;
SELECT name, LENGTH(name) AS char_count FROM artists WHERE LENGTH(name) > 15 ORDER BY char_count DESC, name;
SELECT first_name || ' ' || UPPER(last_name) AS card, role FROM volunteers ORDER BY last_name, first_name, id;

SELECT b.first_name, b.last_name, b.role, COUNT(c.id) AS shift_count FROM volunteers b LEFT JOIN shifts c ON c.volunteer_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.first_name, b.last_name, b.role ORDER BY shift_count DESC, b.last_name, b.first_name, b.id;

SELECT a.name, SUM((strftime('%s', c.end_time) - strftime('%s', c.start_time)) / 60) AS minutes_played FROM artists a JOIN concerts c ON c.artist_id = a.id WHERE c.status = 'Played' GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY a.name, a.id;

SELECT s.name AS stage, c.day, a.name AS artist, ROUND(100.0 * c.audience / s.capacity, 1) AS fill_rate FROM concerts c JOIN stages s ON s.id = c.stage_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = c.artist_id WHERE 100.0 * c.audience / s.capacity >= 90 ORDER BY 100.0 * c.audience / s.capacity DESC, c.day, c.start_time, c.id;

SELECT CASE WHEN purchase_date <= '2025-02-28' THEN 'Presale' ELSE 'Full price' END AS period, pass_type, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM tickets GROUP BY period, pass_type ORDER BY period, pass_type;

SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, b.day AS valid_day, e.day AS entry_day, e.scan_time FROM entries e JOIN tickets b ON b.id = e.ticket_id JOIN festivalgoers f ON f.id = b.festivalgoer_id WHERE b.pass_type = '1-day pass' AND e.day <> b.day ORDER BY e.day, e.scan_time, e.id;

SELECT c.day, s.name AS stage, a.name AS artist, m.rain_mm FROM concerts c JOIN stages s ON s.id = c.stage_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = c.artist_id JOIN weather m ON m.day = c.day WHERE c.status = 'Played' AND s.type = 'Open-air' AND m.rain_mm > 0 ORDER BY c.day, c.start_time, c.id;

SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, b.pass_type FROM tickets b JOIN festivalgoers f ON f.id = b.festivalgoer_id WHERE b.purchase_date = (SELECT MIN(purchase_date) FROM tickets) ORDER BY f.last_name, f.first_name, b.id;
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS artist_count, SUM(COALESCE(fee, 2000)) AS budget FROM artists GROUP BY genre ORDER BY budget DESC, genre;
SELECT day, strftime('%H', scan_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM entries GROUP BY day, strftime('%H', scan_time) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY day, hour;

SELECT e.day, COUNT(*) AS entry_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.pass_type = '3-day pass' THEN e.ticket_id END) AS pass_3_day_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.pass_type = '1-day pass' THEN e.ticket_id END) AS pass_1_day_count FROM entries e JOIN tickets b ON b.id = e.ticket_id GROUP BY e.day ORDER BY e.day;

SELECT g.day, ag.name AS main_stage_artist, asa.name AS willow_artist, (strftime('%s', MIN(g.end_time, s.end_time)) - strftime('%s', MAX(g.start_time, s.start_time))) / 60 AS overlap_minutes FROM concerts g JOIN stages sg ON sg.id = g.stage_id JOIN concerts s ON s.day = g.day JOIN stages ss ON ss.id = s.stage_id JOIN artists ag ON ag.id = g.artist_id JOIN artists asa ON asa.id = s.artist_id WHERE sg.name = 'Main Stage' AND ss.name = 'Willow Stage' AND g.status = 'Played' AND s.status = 'Played' AND g.start_time < s.end_time AND s.start_time < g.end_time ORDER BY g.day, g.start_time, g.id;

WITH totals AS (SELECT a.id, a.name, SUM(c.audience) AS total_audience FROM artists a JOIN concerts c ON c.artist_id = a.id WHERE c.status = 'Played' GROUP BY a.id, a.name), ranking AS (SELECT id, name, total_audience, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_audience DESC) AS rank FROM totals) SELECT name, total_audience, rank FROM ranking WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank, name, id;

WITH running_order AS (SELECT c.day, s.name AS stage, a.name AS artist, c.start_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.day, c.stage_id ORDER BY c.start_time) AS number FROM concerts c JOIN stages s ON s.id = c.stage_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = c.artist_id WHERE c.status = 'Played') SELECT day, stage, artist, start_time FROM running_order WHERE number = 1 ORDER BY day, start_time;

WITH sales AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM tickets GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', purchase_date)) SELECT month, ticket_count, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_revenue FROM sales ORDER BY month;

WITH sequence AS (SELECT c.volunteer_id, c.day, c.start_time, LAG(c.end_time) OVER (PARTITION BY c.volunteer_id, c.day ORDER BY c.start_time) AS previous_end FROM shifts c) SELECT b.first_name, b.last_name, s.day, s.previous_end, s.start_time, (strftime('%s', s.start_time) - strftime('%s', s.previous_end)) / 60 AS break_minutes FROM sequence s JOIN volunteers b ON b.id = s.volunteer_id WHERE s.previous_end IS NOT NULL AND (strftime('%s', s.start_time) - strftime('%s', s.previous_end)) / 60 < 60 ORDER BY s.day, s.start_time, b.last_name;
SELECT genre, name, fee, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY fee DESC) AS level FROM artists WHERE fee IS NOT NULL ORDER BY genre, level, name;

WITH played AS (SELECT c.id, c.stage_id, s.name AS stage, a.name AS artist, c.audience FROM concerts c JOIN stages s ON s.id = c.stage_id JOIN artists a ON a.id = c.artist_id WHERE c.status = 'Played'), averages AS (SELECT stage_id, AVG(audience) AS average FROM played GROUP BY stage_id) SELECT j.stage, j.artist, j.audience, ROUND(m.average) AS stage_average FROM played j JOIN averages m ON m.stage_id = j.stage_id WHERE j.audience > m.average ORDER BY j.stage, j.audience DESC, j.artist, j.id;

WITH days AS (SELECT DISTINCT day FROM concerts), valid_tickets AS (SELECT j.day, b.id AS ticket_id FROM days j JOIN tickets b ON b.pass_type = '3-day pass' OR b.day = j.day) SELECT v.day, COUNT(DISTINCT v.ticket_id) AS valid_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ticket_id) AS scanned_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT e.ticket_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT v.ticket_id), 1) AS attendance_rate FROM valid_tickets v LEFT JOIN entries e ON e.ticket_id = v.ticket_id AND e.day = v.day GROUP BY v.day ORDER BY v.day;

WITH hours AS (SELECT b.id, b.first_name, b.last_name, b.lead_id, COALESCE(SUM(strftime('%s', c.end_time) - strftime('%s', c.start_time)), 0) / 3600.0 AS total_hours FROM volunteers b LEFT JOIN shifts c ON c.volunteer_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.first_name, b.last_name, b.lead_id) SELECT h.first_name, h.last_name, h.total_hours, r.first_name || ' ' || r.last_name AS lead, r.total_hours AS lead_hours FROM hours h JOIN hours r ON r.id = h.lead_id WHERE h.total_hours > r.total_hours ORDER BY h.total_hours DESC, h.last_name, h.id;

SELECT b.first_name, b.last_name, b.role FROM volunteers b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT day FROM concerts) j WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shifts c WHERE c.volunteer_id = b.id AND c.day = j.day)) ORDER BY b.last_name, b.first_name, b.id;

CREATE TABLE passengers (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name         VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    last_name            VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    nationality    VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    birth_date DATE         NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE airlines (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name   VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    country  VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    code  VARCHAR(3)  NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE aircraft (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    model         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    registration VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    capacity       INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    airline_id   INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (airline_id) REFERENCES airlines(id)
);

CREATE TABLE airports (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name   VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    city VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    country  VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    code  VARCHAR(3)   NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE flights (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    flight_number          VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    airline_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    aircraft_id            INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    departure_airport_id  INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    arrival_airport_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    departure_date         DATE        NOT NULL,
    departure_time        TIME        NOT NULL,
    arrival_time       TIME        NOT NULL,
    status              VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (airline_id)        REFERENCES airlines(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aircraft_id)            REFERENCES aircraft(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (departure_airport_id)  REFERENCES airports(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (arrival_airport_id) REFERENCES airports(id)
);

CREATE TABLE bookings (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    passenger_id      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    flight_id           INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    class           VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    seat            VARCHAR(5)   NOT NULL,
    price             NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    booking_date DATE         NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (passenger_id) REFERENCES passengers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (flight_id)      REFERENCES flights(id),
    UNIQUE (flight_id, seat)    -- un siège ne se vend qu’une fois par vol
);

CREATE TABLE bags (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    weight_kg       NUMERIC(5,2),
    status         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES bookings(id)
);

bases.hopital:
CREATE TABLE departments (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name           VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    floor         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    bed_capacity INTEGER     NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE doctors (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    specialty    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE        NOT NULL,
    department_id    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(id)
);

CREATE TABLE nurses (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    department_id    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE        NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(id)
);

CREATE TABLE patients (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    birth_date DATE        NOT NULL,
    sex           VARCHAR(1)  NOT NULL, -- 'M' ou 'F'
    city          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    registration_date DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE consultations (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    doctor_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    consultation_date DATE        NOT NULL,
    duration_min         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    diagnosis        VARCHAR(100),      -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors(id)
);

CREATE TABLE hospital_stays (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    department_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    doctor_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_date  DATE    NOT NULL,
    end_date    DATE,                   -- NULL = hospitalisation en cours
    bed         VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (department_id) REFERENCES departments(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors(id)
);

CREATE TABLE prescriptions (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    consultation_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    medication      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    dosage          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    duration_days     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (consultation_id) REFERENCES consultations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
    id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name  VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(150)
);

CREATE TABLE dishes (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name          VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    category_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    price         NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    available   BOOLEAN      NOT NULL CHECK (available IN (0, 1)), -- 1 = oui, 0 = non
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
);

CREATE TABLE ingredients (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    unit     VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (unit IN ('kg', 'L', 'piece')),
    stock     NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    alert_threshold NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE dish_ingredients (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    dish_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ingredient_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity      NUMERIC(6,3) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (dish_id) REFERENCES dishes(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients(id),
    UNIQUE (dish_id, ingredient_id)
);

CREATE TABLE customers (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email       VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    phone   VARCHAR(20),
    signup_date DATE NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE waiters (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name       VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE       NOT NULL,
    salary      NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE restaurant_tables (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    number      INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    seat_count   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    location VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL CHECK (location IN ('Dining room', 'Terrace', 'Bar'))
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id      INTEGER,           -- nullable : commande sans compte client
    waiter_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    table_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    order_date  DATE    NOT NULL,
    order_time TIME    NOT NULL,
    party_size   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('In progress', 'Served', 'Paid', 'Cancelled')),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)  REFERENCES customers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (waiter_id) REFERENCES waiters(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (table_id)   REFERENCES restaurant_tables(id)
);

CREATE TABLE order_lines (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    dish_id        INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    quantity       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    unit_price  NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (dish_id)     REFERENCES dishes(id),
    UNIQUE (order_id, dish_id)
);

CREATE TABLE reviews (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    order_id  INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    rating         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comment  VARCHAR(255), -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)   REFERENCES customers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id)
);

bases.zoo:
CREATE TABLE species (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    scientific_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    common_name    VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    animal_class        VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL, -- Mammifère, Oiseau, Reptile, etc.
    diet        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Carnivore, Herbivore, Omnivore
    conservation_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL -- LC, NT, VU, EN, CR
);

CREATE TABLE enclosures (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name        VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    type       VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Savane, Jungle, Aquatique, Volière, etc.
    area_m2 INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    capacity   INTEGER     NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE animals (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    species_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    enclosure_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    birth_date DATE       NOT NULL,
    sex          VARCHAR(1)  NOT NULL, -- M ou F
    weight_kg      NUMERIC(6,2),          -- nullable (pas encore pesé)
    arrival_date  DATE        NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (species_id) REFERENCES species(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (enclosure_id) REFERENCES enclosures(id)
);

CREATE TABLE keepers (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    specialty    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE keeper_assignments (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    keeper_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    enclosure_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_date  DATE    NOT NULL,
    end_date    DATE,                  -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (keeper_id) REFERENCES keepers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (enclosure_id)   REFERENCES enclosures(id)
);

CREATE TABLE meals (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    keeper_id INTEGER,               -- nullable : repas automatique
    meal_date  DATE    NOT NULL,
    meal_time TIME    NOT NULL,
    meal_type  VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,  -- Matin, Midi, Soir
    quantity_kg NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id)   REFERENCES animals(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (keeper_id) REFERENCES keepers(id)
);

CREATE TABLE visitors (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    city          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    signup_date DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tickets (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    visitor_id   INTEGER,             -- nullable : billet anonyme
    visit_date   DATE    NOT NULL,
    ticket_type   VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Adulte, Enfant, Étudiant, Senior, Famille
    price          NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (visitor_id) REFERENCES visitors(id)
);

CREATE TABLE reviews (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    visitor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    review_date   DATE    NOT NULL,
    rating        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comment VARCHAR(255),          -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (visitor_id) REFERENCES visitors(id)
);

bases.fromagerie:
CREATE TABLE producers (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    region    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    country      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    founded_date DATE    NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE milks (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type      VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Vache, Chèvre, Brebis, Bufflonne
    origin   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL  -- Fermier, Industriel
);

CREATE TABLE cheeses (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name           VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    producer_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    milk_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    texture     VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Pâte dure, Pâte molle, Pâte persillée, etc.
    price_per_kg       NUMERIC(7,2) NOT NULL,
    available    BOOLEAN      NOT NULL, -- 1 = oui, 0 = non
    FOREIGN KEY (producer_id) REFERENCES producers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (milk_id)       REFERENCES milks(id)
);

CREATE TABLE ripenings (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cheese_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_days   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    temperature_c NUMERIC(4,1) NOT NULL,
    humidity_pct  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_date    DATE    NOT NULL,
    end_date      DATE,                  -- NULL = affinage en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (cheese_id) REFERENCES cheeses(id)
);

CREATE TABLE batches (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cheese_id  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    ripening_id INTEGER,                -- nullable : lot non encore affiné
    weight_kg    NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    production_date DATE     NOT NULL,
    batch_number  VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY (cheese_id)  REFERENCES cheeses(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ripening_id) REFERENCES ripenings(id)
);

CREATE TABLE customers (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email      VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    city      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    signup_date DATE  NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE sales (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id    INTEGER,              -- nullable : vente au comptoir sans compte
    batch_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    sale_date   DATE         NOT NULL,
    quantity_kg  NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    total_price   NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (batch_id)    REFERENCES batches(id)
);

CREATE TABLE tastings (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    cheese_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tasting_date DATE NOT NULL,
    rating        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comment VARCHAR(255),         -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)  REFERENCES customers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (cheese_id) REFERENCES cheeses(id)
);

bases.labo:
CREATE TABLE teams (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name         VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    field     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Biologie, Chimie, Physique, Informatique, etc.
    founded_date DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE researchers (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    position       VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Doctorant, Post-doc, Chargé de recherche, Directeur
    team_id   INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE      NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES teams(id)
);

CREATE TABLE projects (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title         VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    team_id     INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    budget        NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    start_date    DATE         NOT NULL,
    end_date      DATE,                   -- NULL = projet en cours
    status        VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,  -- En cours, Terminé, Suspendu
    FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES teams(id)
);

CREATE TABLE experiments (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    researcher_id  INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    name           VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    experiment_date DATE      NOT NULL,
    duration_hours  NUMERIC(5,1) NOT NULL,
    status        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,   -- Planifiée, En cours, Terminée
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id)    REFERENCES projects(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (researcher_id) REFERENCES researchers(id)
);

CREATE TABLE samples (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    experiment_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    sample_code VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    sample_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Sang, Eau, Roche, Cellules, etc.
    quantity_mg   NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    collection_date DATE     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (experiment_id) REFERENCES experiments(id)
);

CREATE TABLE results (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    experiment_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    measure        VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    value        NUMERIC(14,4),          -- nullable : résultat non encore obtenu
    unit         VARCHAR(20),
    result_date DATE,                   -- nullable
    validated        BOOLEAN,                -- 1 = validé ; NULL = en attente de validation
    FOREIGN KEY (experiment_id) REFERENCES experiments(id)
);

CREATE TABLE publications (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    title         VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    journal         VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    publication_date DATE,                -- nullable : en préparation
    doi           VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id)
);

CREATE TABLE researcher_assignments (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    researcher_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    project_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    start_date    DATE    NOT NULL,
    end_date      DATE,                   -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (researcher_id) REFERENCES researchers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id)    REFERENCES projects(id)
);

bases.voyages:
CREATE TABLE destinations (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    country      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    continent VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    climate    VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL  -- Tropical, Tempéré, Aride, Polaire
);

CREATE TABLE guides (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    language        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tours (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name            VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    destination_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    duration_days    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    base_price      NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    level         VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Facile, Modéré, Sportif
    FOREIGN KEY (destination_id) REFERENCES destinations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE customers (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    city          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    signup_date DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE bookings (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    tour_id      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    booking_date DATE        NOT NULL,
    traveler_count    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Confirmée, En attente, Annulée
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)  REFERENCES customers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (tour_id) REFERENCES tours(id)
);

CREATE TABLE payments (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    amount        NUMERIC(9,2) NOT NULL,
    payment_date  DATE         NOT NULL,
    method          VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Carte, Virement, Espèces, Chèque
    status         VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Payé, En attente, Remboursé
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES bookings(id)
);

CREATE TABLE guide_assignments (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    guide_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tour_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    start_date  DATE    NOT NULL,
    end_date    DATE,                  -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (guide_id)   REFERENCES guides(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (tour_id) REFERENCES tours(id)
);

CREATE TABLE reviews (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    tour_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rating           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comment    VARCHAR(255),       -- nullable
    review_date      DATE    NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)  REFERENCES customers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (tour_id) REFERENCES tours(id)
);

bases.aquarium:
CREATE TABLE aquarists (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    specialty    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tanks (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name            VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    zone           VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    water_type       VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL,
    volume_liters  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    min_temp_c     DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    max_temp_c     DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    lead_aquarist_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (lead_aquarist_id) REFERENCES aquarists(id)
);

CREATE TABLE residents (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    species       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    category    VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    tank_id    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    headcount     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    arrival_date DATE        NOT NULL,
    origin   VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (tank_id) REFERENCES tanks(id)
);

CREATE TABLE readings (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    tank_id         INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    reading_date       DATE         NOT NULL,
    reading_time      TIME         NOT NULL,
    temperature_c     DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    ph                DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL,
    salinity_g_l      DECIMAL(5,2),            -- NULL en eau douce
    nitrates_mg_l     DECIMAL(5,2),            -- NULL : mesure non faite
    aquarist_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (tank_id)         REFERENCES tanks(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aquarist_id) REFERENCES aquarists(id)
);

CREATE TABLE equipment (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type              VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    tank_id         INTEGER,                 -- NULL : équipement commun
    install_date DATE        NOT NULL,
    status            VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,    -- En service, En panne, En maintenance
    FOREIGN KEY (tank_id) REFERENCES tanks(id)
);

CREATE TABLE interventions (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    equipment_id     INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    intervention_type VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,   -- Panne, Entretien, Remplacement
    start_date        DATE         NOT NULL,
    end_date          DATE,                    -- NULL : en cours
    contractor       VARCHAR(60),             -- NULL : équipe interne
    cost              DECIMAL(8,2) NOT NULL,
    description       VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (equipment_id) REFERENCES equipment(id)
);

CREATE TABLE activities (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name        VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    tank_id  INTEGER,                        -- NULL : pas devant un bassin
    duration_min  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    capacity   INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    price_per_student DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (tank_id) REFERENCES tanks(id)
);

CREATE TABLE bookings (
    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    activity_id       INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    school      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    city              VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    level             VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    activity_date     DATE        NOT NULL,
    start_time        TIME        NOT NULL,
    student_count          INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    chaperone_count INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    status             VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,   -- Confirmée, En attente, Annulée
    FOREIGN KEY (activity_id) REFERENCES activities(id)
);

CREATE TABLE rooms (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name            VARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL,
    theme          VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Aventure, Braquage, Enquête, Épouvante, Famille, Science-fiction
    difficulty     INTEGER      NOT NULL CHECK (difficulty BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    time_limit_min  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    min_players    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    max_players    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    price_per_player   DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
    opening_date DATE                   -- NULL : salle pas encore ouverte
);

CREATE TABLE puzzles (
    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    room_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    step    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    name      VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    type     VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- Cadenas, Fouille, Logique, Manipulation, Observation
    FOREIGN KEY (room_id) REFERENCES rooms(id),
    UNIQUE (room_id, step)
);

CREATE TABLE game_masters (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name        VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    last_name           VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE         NOT NULL,
    languages       VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE teams (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name              VARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    group_type      VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Amis, Entreprise, Famille
    city            VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    captain_first_name VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    captain_last_name    VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    email            VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE bookings (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    team_id        INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    room_id         INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    game_date      DATE         NOT NULL,
    time_slot          TIME         NOT NULL,
    player_count       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    price             DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL,
    channel            VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Site web, Téléphone, Sur place
    booking_date DATE         NOT NULL,
    promo_code       VARCHAR(20),           -- NULL : aucun code
    FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES teams(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (room_id)  REFERENCES rooms(id)
);

CREATE TABLE cancellations (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id    INTEGER      NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    cancellation_date   DATE         NOT NULL,
    reason             VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Empêchement, Groupe incomplet, Maladie, Météo
    refund_amount DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES bookings(id)
);

CREATE TABLE games (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    game_master_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    escaped          INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (escaped IN (0, 1)),
    time_seconds   INTEGER,             -- NULL : l’équipe n’est pas sortie à temps
    hints_requested INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES bookings(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (game_master_id)  REFERENCES game_masters(id)
);

CREATE TABLE hints (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    game_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    puzzle_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    minute    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (game_id) REFERENCES games(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (puzzle_id) REFERENCES puzzles(id)
);

CREATE TABLE reviews (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    game_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    review_date   DATE    NOT NULL,
    rating        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    comment VARCHAR(255),          -- NULL : une note sans commentaire
    FOREIGN KEY (game_id) REFERENCES games(id)
);

schema:
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
/* Schema pedagogique : clients, produits, commandes, et fidelite
   (une fiche de points par client : relation 1-1, lecon relations 1-1, 1-N et N-N). */
CREATE TABLE clients (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  prenom TEXT NOT NULL,
  nom TEXT,
  adresse TEXT,
  ville TEXT,
  age INTEGER CHECK (age >= 0),
  email TEXT UNIQUE,
  telephone TEXT,
  date_inscription TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE produits (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  nom TEXT NOT NULL,
  categorie TEXT,
  prix REAL,
  stock INTEGER CHECK (stock >= 0)
);
CREATE TABLE commandes (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  numero_commande TEXT,
  client_id INTEGER,
  produit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quantite INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantite > 0),
  date_commande TEXT,
  statut TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_preparation',
  FOREIGN KEY (client_id)
    REFERENCES clients(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (produit_id)
    REFERENCES produits(id)
);
